        raise RuntimeError('frozen 7bo builder/checker source pin changed')
    prefix = raw.decode('utf-8').split(BUILDER_MARKER, 1)[0]
    if len(prefix.encode('utf-8')) == len(raw):
        raise RuntimeError('builder/checker separation marker absent')
    module = types.ModuleType('_d0_cold_jet_owned_builder')
    module.__file__ = str(BUILDER_FILE)
    sys.modules[module.__name__] = module
    exec(compile(prefix, str(BUILDER_FILE), 'exec'), module.__dict__)
    module.PROVENANCE = {
        'builder_source_path': str(BUILDER_FILE),
        'builder_source': 'frozen7bo fencedcode; fullcurrentmemo length not pinned',
        'fenced_program_with_newline_bytes': len(raw),
        'fenced_program_with_newline_sha256': hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest(),
        'builder_fenced_code_bytes': len(code),
        'builder_fenced_code_sha256': hashlib.sha256(code).hexdigest(),
        'loaded_prefix_bytes': len(prefix.encode('utf-8')),
        'loaded_prefix_sha256': hashlib.sha256(prefix.encode('utf-8')).hexdigest(),
        'full_select_math_was_executed': False,
    }
    return module


owned = load_builder()
Compiler = owned.Compiler
ne = owned.ne


def parked_g(c, q):
    return c.park(q, c.g(q))


def controlled_reflection(c, source, data_target, frame):
    """Chronology U†;CZ(source,d);U, hence controlled H=U Z_d U†."""
    return c.seq(c.inv(frame), c.cz(source, data_target), frame)


def cold_cell(c, source_pair, data_target, frame=None, identity=False):
    """A;M;A† with M blocks I,H,-H,-I.  No source/target measurement."""
    s0, s1 = tuple(source_pair)
    for q in (s0, s1, data_target):
        c._work(q)
    if len({s0, s1, data_target}) != 3:
        raise ne.DomainError('SOURCE pair and DATA target must be disjoint')
    if frame is None:
        frame = c.seq()
    c._check_tree(frame)
    # Frame support must be DATA/helper only, not this cell's SOURCE bits.
    leaves = c._leaves(frame, tuple(range(c.qubits)))
    if any(set(g.wires).intersection((s0, s1)) for g in leaves):
        raise ne.DomainError('reflection frame touches its SOURCE control')
    A = c.seq(parked_g(c, s0), parked_g(c, s1))
    if identity:
        middle = c.phase(s0, 2)
    else:
        middle = c.seq(c.phase(s0, 2),
                       controlled_reflection(c, s0, data_target, frame),
                       controlled_reflection(c, s1, data_target, frame))
    word = c.seq(A, middle, c.inv(A))
    return {'birth': A, 'middle': middle, 'birth_inverse': c.inv(A),
            'frame': frame, 'word': word, 'identity_reflection': identity,
            'source_pair': (s0, s1), 'data_target': data_target}


def build_four_cells():
    """Actual requested 16-wire layout.  No 65536-dimensional matrix built."""
    c = Compiler(16, 8, (13, 14), (15,))
    data = (9, 10, 11, 12)
    d0, d1, d2, d3 = data
    F = c.seq(c.cx(d1, d0), c.cz(d1, d2), c.cz(d1, d3))
    Ux = c.seq(parked_g(c, d1), F)
    Uy = c.seq(parked_g(c, d1), c.phase(d1), F)
    frames = (c.seq(), c.seq(), Ux, Uy)
    names = ('I', 'Z1', 'Hx', 'Hy')
    cells = tuple(cold_cell(c, (2*j, 2*j+1), d1, frames[j], identity=(j == 0))
                  for j in range(4))
    word = c.seq(*(cell['word'] for cell in cells))
    return {'compiler': c, 'data': data, 'frames': frames,
            'names': names, 'cells': cells, 'word': word,
            'blank_wires': tuple(range(9)),
            'report_bits': tuple(range(8))}


def inventory_report():
    """Materialize only the small 918-stage WORD, never a full CAR matrix."""
    built = build_four_cells()
    c, word = built['compiler'], built['word']

    counts = c.counts(word)
    leaves = c._leaves(word, tuple(range(c.qubits)))
    assert all(g.wires == (8,) for g in leaves if g.op == 'G')
    assert all(g.wires == (8, 13, 14) for g in leaves if g.op == 'SourceI')
    assert all(set(g.wires).isdisjoint(c.old) for g in leaves)
    assert all(set(g.wires).isdisjoint(c.spin) for g in leaves if g.op != 'SourceI')
    execution = c.execution(word, blank_wires=built['blank_wires'],
                            report_bits=built['report_bits'],
                            max_expanded_stages=counts.n)
    iv = ne.inventory(execution, max_qubits=16, max_expanded_stages=counts.n)
    assert (iv.g_count, iv.cx_count, iv.source_i_count, iv.gate_count) == (
        counts.g, counts.cx, counts.source_i, counts.n)
    assert iv.cut_rank == 16*4*2
    inverse = tuple(c.iter_raw(c.inv(word)))
    wanted = ne.inverse_word(execution, max_qubits=16,
                             max_expanded_stages=len(inverse))
    assert inverse == wanted
    assert len(inverse) == c.counts(c.inv(word)).n
    components = {}
    for name, cell in zip(built['names'], built['cells']):
        components[name] = {k: c.counts(cell[k]).as_dict()
                            for k in ('frame', 'birth', 'middle', 'birth_inverse', 'word')}
    return {
        'layout': {'qubits': 16, 'physical_port': 8,
                   'SOURCE_pairs': ((0, 1), (2, 3), (4, 5), (6, 7)),
                   'CAR_role_wires': built['data'], 'phase_Spin': (13, 14),
                   'immutable_oldRIGHT': (15,),
                   'blank_wires': built['blank_wires'],
                   'unknown_wires': iv.unknown_wires},
        'components': components,
        'total': counts.as_dict(),
        'raw_inverse_total': c.counts(c.inv(word)).as_dict(),
        'unique_leaf_validation': validation,
        'literal_full_word_validated': True,
        'literal_full_word_gates': len(execution.gates),
        'literal_inverse_equals_owned': True,
        'input_rank_with_one_old_qubit': iv.cut_rank,
        'full_dimension_with_one_old_qubit': iv.full_dimension,
        'general_input_rank': '64 * genuine_oldRIGHT_rank',
        'general_full_dimension': '32768 * genuine_oldRIGHT_dimension',
        'initial_cut': 'SOURCE8+physicalP blank; CAR16+Spin4+oldRIGHT free',
        'completed_physical_port': 'identity on every P input column',
        'four_CAR_matrix_was_built': False,
        'fresh_source_is_free_incoming_density': False,
        'AST_is_native_primitive': False,
    }


def run_small_fixtures():
    """Only two NEW 64-column examples, with H=Z and H=GZG†."""
    import sympy as s
    c = Compiler(6, 0, (4, 5))
    I = s.eye(64)
    passed = []

    def mat(word):
        e = c.execution(word)
        return ne.word_matrix(e, max_qubits=6, max_expanded_stages=len(e.gates))

    for name, frame in (('Z', c.seq()), ('GZGdagger', parked_g(c, 3))):
        parts = cold_cell(c, (1, 2), 3, frame)
        e = c.execution(parts['word'], blank_wires=(0, 1, 2))
        N = len(e.gates)
        M = mat(parts['middle'])
        W = ne.word_matrix(e, max_qubits=6, max_expanded_stages=N)
        G = ne.G_LOCAL
        H = s.diag(1, -1) if name == 'Z' else G*s.diag(1, -1)*G.T
        blocks = (s.eye(2), H, -H, -s.eye(2))
        target = s.zeros(64)
        # Wire0 is P,1/2 are SOURCE,3 DATA,4/5 Spin.  P and Spin are
        # arbitrary on EVERY one of the 64 columns, not selected helpers.
        for column in range(64):
            src = (column >> 3) & 3
            data_in = (column >> 2) & 1
            for data_out in (0, 1):
                row = (column & ~(1 << 2)) | (data_out << 2)
                target[row, column] = blocks[src][data_out, data_in]
        assert ne.exact_matrix_equal(M, target)
        assert ne.exact_matrix_equal(M.T*M, I)
        assert ne.exact_matrix_equal(W.T*W, I)
        assert ne.exact_matrix_equal(W*W, I)
        j = ne.input_isometry(e, max_qubits=6, max_expanded_stages=N)
        cold = j.T*W*j
        assert ne.exact_matrix_equal(cold, ne.P**3*s.eye(8))
        # The COMPLETE operator is I_P tensor a matrix on source/DATA/Spin.
        assert ne.exact_matrix_equal(W[:32, :32], W[32:, 32:])
        assert ne.exact_matrix_equal(W[:32, 32:], s.zeros(32))
        assert ne.exact_matrix_equal(W[32:, :32], s.zeros(32))
        actual_inverse = tuple(c.iter_raw(c.inv(parts['word'])))
        wanted_inverse = ne.inverse_word(e, max_qubits=6,
                                        max_expanded_stages=len(actual_inverse))
        assert actual_inverse == wanted_inverse
        passed.append({'fixture': name, 'all_columns': 64,
                       'counts': c.counts(parts['word']).as_dict(),
                       'middle_diagonal_blocks': 'I,H,-H,-I',
                       'cold_corner': 'p^3 I8', 'Spin_all_columns': True,
                       'port_all_columns_restored': True,
                       'owned_raw_inverse': True})
    return passed


def main():
    report = inventory_report()
    tests = run_small_fixtures()
    print('PROVENANCE', json.dumps(owned.PROVENANCE, sort_keys=True))
    print('EXACT_FOUR_CELL_INVENTORY', json.dumps(report, sort_keys=True))
    print('NEW_BOUNDED_FIXTURES', json.dumps(tests, sort_keys=True))
    print('PASS 2 new complete 64-column cold cells; actual full word/inverse membership; no full-CAR matrix or old suite')
    return report, tests

def run_semantic_fixture():
    """NEW 32-column semantic cell/copy check; does not replay old 64-column words."""
    import sympy as sp
    G = ne.G_LOCAL
    I2 = sp.eye(2)
    Z = sp.diag(1, -1)
    A = sp.kronecker_product(G, G, I2)
    M = sp.diag(I2, Z, -Z, -I2)
    core = A.T * M * A
    copy = sp.zeros(32)
    for col in range(32):
        # SOURCE wires0/1 (MSB), DATA2, archive3/4.
        row = col ^ (((col >> 4) & 1) << 1) ^ ((col >> 3) & 1)
        copy[row, col] = 1
    assert copy.T * copy == sp.eye(32) and copy*copy == sp.eye(32)
    U = copy * sp.kronecker_product(core, sp.eye(4)) * copy
    assert ne.exact_matrix_equal(U.T*U, sp.eye(32))
    j = sp.zeros(32, 2)
    for data in range(2):
        j[data << 2, data] = 1
    out = U*j
    assert ne.exact_matrix_equal(j.T*U*j, ne.P**3*I2)
    source_j = sp.zeros(8, 2)
    source_j[:2, :] = I2
    core_out = core*source_j
    for z in range(4):
        P_source = sp.diag(*(int((row >> 3) == z) for row in range(32)))
        P_archive = sp.diag(*(int((row & 3) == z) for row in range(32)))
        Kz = core_out[2*z:2*z+2, :]
        assert ne.exact_matrix_equal(P_source*out, P_archive*out)
        assert ne.exact_matrix_equal(out.T*P_archive*out, Kz.T*Kz)
    assert ne.exact_matrix_equal(out.T*out, I2)
    return {
        'all_columns_unitary': 32,
        'initial_boundary': 'SOURCE00,archive00; arbitrary DATA2',
        'middle_blocks': 'I,Z,-Z,-I', 'cold_corner_unchanged': 'p^3 I2',
        'all_four_terminal_SOURCE_label_effects_equal_archive': True,
        'archive_effects_are_complete_including_nonreturn': True,
        'birth_source_labels_were_not_claimed': True,
        'this_is_not_the_large_native_4CAR_matrix': True,
    }

"""New exact SOURCE-CQ identities only; no old fixture or repository imports.

All logarithms are natural.  The entropy identities use 0 < u < 1.
The decimal strings at the end are diagnostics, never proof tolerances.
No tariff, additional action term, physical record availability or native
continuous-angle admission is inferred by this checker.
"""
import json
import sympy as sp


def run_exact_cq_math():
    aa, pp = sp.symbols('aa pp', positive=True, real=True)
    gb = sp.groebner((aa**2-pp, pp**2+pp-1), aa, pp)

    def reduced(x):
        return gb.reduce(sp.expand(x))[1]

    def eq(A, B):
        return A.shape == B.shape and all(reduced(x-y) == 0 for x, y in zip(A, B))

    I2 = sp.eye(2)
    Z = sp.diag(1, -1)
    Pplus, Pminus = (I2+Z)/2, (I2-Z)/2
    theta0, theta1 = sp.symbols('theta0 theta1', real=True)

    def rotation(t):
        return sp.Matrix(((sp.cos(t), -sp.sin(t)),
                          (sp.sin(t), sp.cos(t))))

    # Literal two-SOURCE cell.  Source indices are 00,01,10,11.
    middle = sp.diag(I2, Z, -Z, -I2)
    birth = sp.kronecker_product(rotation(theta0), rotation(theta1), I2)
    cell = birth.T*middle*birth
    expected = (sp.cos(2*theta0)*Pplus+sp.cos(2*theta1)*Pminus,
                -sp.sin(2*theta1)*Pminus,
                -sp.sin(2*theta0)*Pplus, sp.zeros(2))
    for index, K in enumerate(expected):
        difference = cell[2*index:2*index+2, :2]-K
        assert all(sp.trigsimp(x) == 0 for x in difference)
    assert all(sp.trigsimp(x) == 0 for x in
               sum((K.T*K for K in expected), sp.zeros(2))-I2)

    # At matched angles the four Kraus maps are cI,-sP-,-sP+,0.
    cc = pp**3
    ss = 2*aa*pp
    assert reduced(cc**2+ss**2-1) == 0
    matched = (cc*I2, -ss*Pminus, -ss*Pplus, sp.zeros(2))
    assert eq(sum((K.T*K for K in matched), sp.zeros(2)), I2)

    # A genuinely mixed, nondiagonal rational DATA input.
    rho = sp.Matrix(((sp.Rational(3, 5), sp.Rational(1, 5)),
                     (sp.Rational(1, 5), sp.Rational(2, 5))))
    assert rho.trace() == 1 and rho.det() == sp.Rational(1, 5)
    lam = (sp.Rational(1, 2)+sp.sqrt(5)/10,
           sp.Rational(1, 2)-sp.sqrt(5)/10)
    assert sum(lam) == 1 and sp.simplify(lam[0]*lam[1]-rho.det()) == 0
    assert rho != Pplus*rho*Pplus+Pminus*rho*Pminus
    Srho = -sum(x*sp.log(x) for x in lam)
    tt = sp.Rational(3, 5)
    h = lambda x: -x*sp.log(x)-(1-x)*sp.log(1-x)
    deltaS = h(tt)-Srho
    u = sp.symbols('u', positive=True, real=True)

    def log_normal(x):
        # The stated domain 0<u<1 and positive eigenvalues justify expansion.
        return sp.simplify(sp.expand_log(sp.expand(x), force=True))

    # Compute the actual complete CQ blocks, retaining K00's mixed entropy.
    gamma_blocks = ((1-u)*rho, u*Pminus*rho*Pminus,
                    u*Pplus*rho*Pplus, sp.zeros(2))
    assert sp.simplify(sum(G.trace() for G in gamma_blocks)-1) == 0
    eig_nonzero = ((1-u)*lam[0], (1-u)*lam[1], u*tt, u*(1-tt))
    # The 6x6 CQ form records 00,10,01.  The literal four-label 8x8
    # form has in addition the explicitly zero 11 branch, retained above.
    gamma6 = sp.diag(gamma_blocks[0], gamma_blocks[2], gamma_blocks[1])
    eig_parameter = sp.symbols('eig_parameter')
    exact_eig_poly = eig_parameter**2*sp.prod(eig_parameter-x for x in eig_nonzero)
    difference = sp.Poly(sp.expand(gamma6.charpoly(eig_parameter).as_expr()
                                   -exact_eig_poly), eig_parameter)
    assert all(sp.simplify(x) == 0 for x in difference.all_coeffs())
    # The other four eigenvalues of the 8x8 CQ state are structural zeros.
    entropy_from_blocks = -sum(x*sp.log(x) for x in eig_nonzero)
    info_from_blocks = entropy_from_blocks-Srho
    info_formula = h(u)+u*deltaS
    assert log_normal(info_from_blocks-info_formula) == 0
    derivative_formula = sp.log((1-u)/u)+deltaS
    assert log_normal(sp.diff(info_from_blocks, u)-derivative_formula) == 0
    # Using only the classical three-label Shannon entropy would be wrong.
    label_shannon = h(u)+u*h(tt)
    assert log_normal(label_shannon-info_from_blocks-u*Srho) == 0
    assert Srho != 0

    th = sp.symbols('th', real=True)
    assert sp.trigsimp(sp.diff(sp.sin(2*th)**2, th)
                       -4*sp.sin(2*th)*sp.cos(2*th)) == 0

    # Full four-cell/256-label statement is structural, not a 512x512 allocation.
    # I-cell contributes (cI,0,-sI,0) independently of the other three cells.
    # On an abstract fixed rest spectrum w=(2/3,1/3), verify the tensor entropy.
    # This is the spectral identity used for ANY Gamma_rest, not an input model.
    rest = (sp.Rational(2, 3), sp.Rational(1, 3))
    Srest = -sum(x*sp.log(x) for x in rest)
    full_tensor_eigs = tuple(q*x for q in (1-u, u) for x in rest)
    Sfull_tensor = -sum(x*sp.log(x) for x in full_tensor_eigs)
    assert log_normal(Sfull_tensor-h(u)-Srest) == 0
    assert log_normal(sp.diff(Sfull_tensor, u)-sp.log((1-u)/u)) == 0

    # A copied COMMON source lives only in 00/11 and loses every H coefficient.
    corr = sp.Matrix((sp.cos(th), 0, 0, sp.sin(th)))
    jcorr = sp.kronecker_product(corr, I2)
    corr_cold = jcorr.T*middle*jcorr
    assert all(sp.trigsimp(x) == 0 for x in corr_cold-sp.cos(2*th)*I2)
    assert sp.trigsimp(sp.trace(Z*sp.diff(corr_cold, th))) == 0

    # Retain BOTH birth-source copies and do not uncopy them.  Their actual
    # all-zero return condition selects SOURCE00: the corner is p^2, not p^3.
    G = sp.Matrix(((aa, -pp), (pp, aa)))
    Asource = sp.kronecker_product(G, G)
    A32 = sp.kronecker_product(Asource, sp.eye(4), I2)
    copy16 = sp.zeros(16)
    for source in range(4):
        for record in range(4):
            copy16[4*source+(record ^ source), 4*source+record] = 1
    copy32 = sp.kronecker_product(copy16, I2)
    M32 = sp.diag(*(sp.kronecker_product(sp.eye(4), block)
                    for block in (I2, Z, -Z, -I2)))
    j32 = sp.zeros(32, 2)
    j32[0, 0] = j32[1, 1] = 1
    copied_corner = j32.T*A32.T*M32*copy32*A32*j32
    assert eq(copied_corner, pp**2*I2)
    assert reduced(pp**2-pp**3) != 0

    # Exact rational inequalities prove the entropy-source floors.
    pexact = (sp.sqrt(5)-1)/2
    assert (pexact-sp.Rational(3, 5)).is_positive is True
    assert (sp.Rational(2, 3)-pexact).is_positive is True
    assert (sp.sqrt(pexact)-sp.Rational(3, 4)).is_positive is True
    # Taylor to order3; every subsequent term ratio is <=1/5.
    exp1_upper = sum(sp.Rational(1, sp.factorial(k)) for k in range(4))
    exp1_upper += sp.Rational(1, 24)/(1-sp.Rational(1, 5))
    assert exp1_upper == sp.Rational(87, 32) and exp1_upper < 3
    prefactor_lower = 8*sp.Rational(3, 4)*sp.Rational(3, 5)**4
    assert prefactor_lower == sp.Rational(486, 625)
    assert prefactor_lower > sp.Rational(3, 4)
    assert 2*prefactor_lower > sp.Rational(3, 2)

    fixture_negative_derivative = pref*(sp.log(4/pexact**3)-deltaS)
    return {

        'I_cell_info': 'h(u)+I_rest',

        'physical_terminal_record_availability_proved': False,
        'numerical_diagnostics_only': {

# Actual common-carrier source binding; no Gibbs preparation or new action.
def run_binding_math():
    p=ne.P;a=ne.A;c=p**3;s=2*a*p;chi=p**12
    z=sp.Rational(1,2**20);r=8192;bheat=2*p*p;ell=-sp.log(p)
    u=s*s;uprime=4*s*c;Q=1-z+z*chi**2
    assert ne.exact_matrix_equal(sp.Matrix([[u+c*c]]),sp.ones(1))
    Iprime=uprime*sp.log(c*c/u)
    Jprime=8*r*z*a*p*chi*c**3/Q
    # The complete entropy is normalized. Only J carries the raw rank8192.
    assert (p-sp.Rational(3,5)).is_positive is True
    assert (sp.Rational(2,3)-p).is_positive is True
    assert (a-sp.Rational(3,4)).is_positive is True
    assert (1-bheat).is_positive is True
    # Bounds already proved for the base jet, now on the actual copied corner.
    assert sp.Rational(3,128)*sp.Rational(3,5)**22>sp.Rational(1,4_000_000)
    Jlower=sp.Rational(1,2_000_000);Hupper=sp.Rational(1,8_000_000)
    assert Jlower-Hupper==sp.Rational(3,8_000_000)>0
    # Exact Gibbs identity on a faithful full-Hodge reference tau.
    beta,l,C,Sin,Sout,H,J,R=sp.symbols('beta ell C Sin Sout H J R',real=True)
    Igain=Sout-Sin;P=C-Igain/l
    Drel=-Sout+beta*R+beta*H
    discrepancy=beta*J+l*C+Sin+Drel
    assert sp.expand(beta*(H+J+R)+l*P-discrepancy)==0
    # Stage0 energy: arbitrary temporal gate blocks have no same-stage entry.
    B=sp.Matrix(2,2,sp.symbols('b0:4',real=True))
    Rscene=sp.diag(*sp.symbols('r0:2',real=True))
    temporal=sp.zeros(6)
    for stage in range(3):
        g=sp.Matrix(2,2,sp.symbols('g%d_0:4'%stage,real=True))
        out=2*((stage+1)%3);inc=2*stage
        temporal[out:out+2,inc:inc+2]=g
    metric=sp.kronecker_product(sp.eye(3),Rscene)
    Delta=sp.eye(6)-sp.kronecker_product(sp.eye(3),B)-metric*(temporal+temporal.T)*metric
    assert Delta[:2,:2]==sp.eye(2)-B
    # With fixed scene marginal and input, R'=0 and Sin'=0. Keep moving tau.
    Hp,Jp,Cp,Ip=sp.symbols('Hp Jp Cp Ip',real=True)
    Drelp=beta*Hp-Ip
    mathDp=beta*Jp+l*Cp+Drelp
    assert sp.expand(mathDp-(beta*(Hp+Jp)+l*Cp-Ip))==0
    # Fixed actual branch-WORK operators: retain their operator difference.
    uu,dc=sp.symbols('u dc',real=True)
    entropy_coin=-uu*sp.log(uu)-(1-uu)*sp.log(1-uu)
    Dprice=sp.diff(l*(sp.Symbol('C0')+uu*dc)-entropy_coin,uu)
    assert sp.simplify(sp.expand_log(Dprice,force=True)-(l*dc+sp.log(uu)-sp.log(1-uu)))==0
    required_delta=sp.log(c*c/u)/ell
    # This is a necessary ACTUAL work reaction, never an assigned tariff.
    assert sp.simplify(ell*required_delta+sp.log(u/(c*c)))==0
    return {
        'Gibbs_identity_units':'beta*(H+J+R)+ell*P = beta*J+ell*C+Sin+D(Gamma||tau)',
        'P_definition':'C-I_CQ/ell; not an extra term appended to bareBook',
        'stage0_R_value':'Tr(scene_birth*(I-B_scene)); not zeroed',
        'stage0_SOURCE_R_derivative':0,
        'fixed_width_storage_length':8,'fixed_width_storage_derivative':0,
        'copied_cut_rank':r,'CQ_entropy_gets_raw_rank_multiplier':False,
        'strict_thermal_angle_upper':'1/8000000',
        'strict_Book_angle_lower':'1/2000000',
        'strict_H01_plus_J_angle_lower':'3/8000000',
        'strict_minus_CQ_Info_coin_angle_lower':'3/2',
        'strict_full_binding_discrepancy_derivative_lower':'3/2 for actual constant C',
        'full_binding_discrepancy_was_assumed_stationary':False,
        'fixed_branch_charge_difference_needed_for_P_stationarity':str(required_delta),
        'moving_external_cost_and_quantum_work_sources_retained':True,
        'numerical_diagnostics_only':{'coin_I_derivative':str(sp.N(Iprime,24)),
            'Book_I_cell_angle_derivative':str(sp.N(Jprime,24)),
            'necessary_work_difference':str(sp.N(required_delta,24)),
            'ell':str(sp.N(ell,24))},
    }

def build_attempt():
    """Only ONE actual native attempt, on the requested compact 12-wire frame."""
    c = Compiler(12, 0, (7, 8), (9,))
    parts = owned.cold_cell(c, (1, 2), 4, c.seq())
    copy = c.seq(c.cx(1, 10), c.cx(2, 11))
    word = c.seq(copy, parts['word'], copy)
    blanks = (0, 1, 2, 10, 11)
    e = c.execution(word, blank_wires=blanks, report_bits=(10, 11),
                    max_expanded_stages=98)
    return {'compiler': c, 'word': word, 'copy': copy,
            'cell': parts, 'execution': e}


def attempt_report():
    built = build_attempt()
    c, word, e = built['compiler'], built['word'], built['execution']
    validation = c.validate(word)
    assert c.counts(built['cell']['word']).as_dict() == {
        'G': 4, 'CX': 70, 'SourceI': 20, 'N': 94, 'g_port': 4, 'g_off': 0}
    expected = {'G': 4, 'CX': 74, 'SourceI': 20,
                'N': 98, 'g_port': 4, 'g_off': 0}
    assert c.counts(word).as_dict() == expected and len(e.gates) == 98
    iv = ne.inventory(e, max_qubits=12, max_expanded_stages=98)
    assert (iv.g_count, iv.cx_count, iv.source_i_count, iv.gate_count) == (4, 74, 20, 98)
    assert iv.cut_rank == 128 and iv.full_dimension == 4096
    leaves = c._leaves(word, tuple(range(12)))
    assert all(g.wires == (0,) for g in leaves if g.op == 'G')
    assert all(g.wires == (0, 7, 8) for g in leaves if g.op == 'SourceI')
    assert all(set(g.wires).isdisjoint((9,)) for g in leaves)
    assert all(set(g.wires).isdisjoint((7, 8)) for g in leaves if g.op != 'SourceI')
    for source, archive in ((1, 10), (2, 11)):
        assert tuple(g for g in e.gates if archive in g.wires) == (
            ne.Gate('CX', (source, archive)),) * 2
    inverse = tuple(c.iter_raw(c.inv(word)))
    assert inverse == ne.inverse_word(e, max_qubits=12,
                                      max_expanded_stages=len(inverse))
    assert len(inverse) == 154
    assert c.counts(c.inv(word)).as_dict() == {
        'G': 4, 'CX': 74, 'SourceI': 76,
        'N': 154, 'g_port': 4, 'g_off': 0}
    return {
        'layout': {'qubits': 12, 'physical_port': 0, 'SOURCE': (1, 2),
                   'DATA_roles': (3, 4, 5, 6), 'H': 'Z on role1 wire4',
                   'phase_Spin': (7, 8), 'immutable_oldRIGHT': (9,),
                   'terminal_archive': (10, 11),
                   'blank_wires': e.blank_wires, 'unknown_wires': iv.unknown_wires},
        'literal_attempt_counts': expected,
        'literal_inverse_counts': c.counts(c.inv(word)).as_dict(),
        'literal_inverse_equals_owned': True, 'unique_leaf_validation': validation,
        'input_rank_one_old_qubit': iv.cut_rank,
        'general_input_rank': '64 * genuine_oldRIGHT_rank',
        'general_active_dimension': '2048 * genuine_oldRIGHT_dimension',
        'true_oldRIGHT128_input_rank': 8192,
        'true_oldRIGHT128_active_dimension': 2*4*4*16*4*128,
        'true_oldRIGHT128_physical33_dimension': 33*4*4*16*4*128,
        'owned_instrument': 'K00=p^3 I, K01=−2ap P_minus, K10=−2ap P_plus, K11=0',
        'instrument_scope': 'owned7bq564; no new operator matrix fixture executed',
        'only_one_attempt_Execution_emitted': True,
        'DATA_reset_or_discarded': False,
        'readout_or_STOP_primitive_emitted': False,
        'Cost_assigned_from_Gate_count': False,
    }


def _cap(value):
    if type(value) is not int or value < 1:
        raise ne.DomainError('cap must be a positive finite integer')
    return value


def stopping_rule_instantiation(cap=3):
    """Finite table INSTANCE of the OWNED first-event/cap rule, not its proof."""
    cap = _cap(cap)
    table = []
    for attempt in range(1, cap+1):
        for label in ('00', '01', '10', '11'):
            if label == '00' and attempt < cap:
                nxt, status = f'ACTIVE({attempt+1})', 'quiet_continue'
            elif label == '00':
                nxt, status = 'HALTED', 'cap_abort_after_quiet'
            elif label in ('01', '10'):
                nxt, status = 'HALTED', 'first_bright_stop'
            else:
                nxt, status = 'HALTED', 'structural_zero_label_retained'
            table.append({'state': f'ACTIVE({attempt})', 'read_label': label,
                          'append_record': {'attempt': attempt, 'label': label},
                          'next_state': nxt, 'status': status,
                          'readout_and_transition_price': 'ACTUAL_LEDGER_REQUIRED'})
    # These are addresses for FRESH work in this instantiation, not a global
    # fixed-body Execution.  Earlier source+archive registers are never reused.
    resources = []
    sealed = []
    for attempt in range(1, cap+1):
        if attempt == 1:
            source, archive = (1, 2), (10, 11)
        else:
            start = 12+4*(attempt-2)
            source, archive = (start, start+1), (start+2, start+3)
        resources.append({'attempt': attempt, 'fresh_SOURCE': source,
                          'fresh_archive': archive,
                          'shared_port_DATA_Spin': (0, (3, 4, 5, 6), (7, 8)),
                          'immutable_initial_oldRIGHT': (9,),
                          'sealed_previous_attempt_registers_excluded': tuple(sealed),
                          'shared_port_input0': 'returned by preceding attempt; no reset supplied',
                          'DATA_input': 'actual conditional continuation state, never reset'})
        sealed.extend(source+archive)
    return {
        'owned_rule': 'STOPPED_CLOCK_SOURCE.md section2 equation3',
        'instantiation_only': True, 'cap': cap, 'initial_state': 'ACTIVE(1)',
        'transition_table': table, 'fresh_resource_plan': resources,
        'label_order': 'SOURCE1,2 and archive10,11 in the compact per-attempt frame',
        'all_times_abort_and_zero_labels_registered': True,
        'conditional_readout_and_halting_admission': 'UNCHANGED_OWNED_OBLIGATION',
        'real_controller_and_duration_price': 'ACTUAL_LEDGER_REQUIRED',
        'controller_was_compiled_to_G_CX_SourceI': False,
        'coherent_fixed_98K_body_was_constructed': False,
        'global_cap_gate_Execution_was_constructed': False,
    }


def terminal_branch_ledger(cap=3):
    """All finite first-event/cap leaves and their literal ATTEMPT-only counts."""
    cap = _cap(cap)
    out = []
    for attempt in range(1, cap+1):
        for label in ('01', '10', '11'):
            history = ('00',)*(attempt-1)+(label,)
            out.append(_branch_entry(attempt, history,
                        'structural_zero_retained' if label == '11' else 'first_bright'))
    out.append(_branch_entry(cap, ('00',)*cap, 'cap_abort_unresolved'))
    assert len(out) == 3*cap+1
    return out


def _branch_entry(attempts, history, status):
    return {
        'history': history,
        'registered_attempt_times': tuple(range(1, attempts+1)),
        'status': status, 'executed_attempts': attempts,
        'attempt_primitive_counts': {'G': 4*attempts, 'CX': 74*attempts,
                                     'SourceI': 20*attempts, 'N': 98*attempts},
        'actual_total_primitive_duration': f'{98*attempts} + N_controller(history)',
        'controller_readout_stopping_ledger': 'ACTUAL_LEDGER_REQUIRED; NOT ZERO',
        'fresh_SOURCE_bits_executed': 2*attempts,
        'fresh_archive_bits_executed': 2*attempts,
        'previous_records_overwritten': False,
        'all_fine_labels_retained_including_structural_zero': True,
        'old_RIGHT_touched': False, 'DATA_reset': False,
        'unexecuted_later_attempts_were_charged': False,
        'unexecuted_resource_or_controller_cost_was_declared_zero': False,
    }


def main():
    report = attempt_report()
    spec = stopping_rule_instantiation(3)
    leaves = terminal_branch_ledger(3)
    assert len(spec['transition_table']) == 12 and len(leaves) == 10
    print('PROVENANCE', json.dumps(owned.STOP_PROVENANCE, sort_keys=True))
    print('ONE_LITERAL_ATTEMPT', json.dumps(report, sort_keys=True))
    print('OWNED_STOP_RULE_K3_INSTANCE', json.dumps(spec, sort_keys=True))
    print('ATTEMPT_ONLY_BRANCH_LEDGER', json.dumps(leaves, sort_keys=True))
    print('PASS COUNTS ONLY: ONE98-gate attempt/inverse154; K3 owned-rule table; no matrix or cap-wide native execution')
    return report, spec, leaves

"""Exact scalar-quiet specialization of the OWNED first-event/cap calculus.

Owner: d0_native_minimality_closure_2026-10-20/prospective/STOPPED_CLOCK_SOURCE.md,
especially its retained isometry (3), marked operator (6), and source (7).
Changed input only: Kquiet=cI, Kbright=-sP+/-, c²+s²=1.  No new
Bellman objective, physical stopping controller, reset or selected tariff.
Finite cap always retains its actual abort.  Every equality below is exact;
there is no numerical decision tolerance and no old test/fixture import.
"""
import json
import sympy as sp


def run_scalar_quiet_stop_math():
    c, s = sp.symbols('c s', positive=True, real=True)
    gb = sp.groebner((s*s+c*c-1,), s, c, domain=sp.QQ)

    def reduce(x):
        return gb.reduce(sp.expand(x))[1]

    def eq(A, B):
        return A.shape == B.shape and all(reduce(x-y) == 0 for x, y in zip(A, B))

    I = sp.eye(2)
    P = (sp.diag(1, 0), sp.diag(0, 1))
    rho = sp.Matrix(((sp.Rational(3, 5), sp.Rational(1, 5)),
                     (sp.Rational(1, 5), sp.Rational(2, 5))))
    pinch = sum((Q*rho*Q for Q in P), sp.zeros(2))
    assert rho.det() == sp.Rational(1, 5) and rho != pinch
    caps = (1, 2, 3, 5)
    for K in caps:
        branches = tuple(-s*c**(n-1)*Q for n in range(1, K+1) for Q in P)
        abort = c**K*I
        assert eq(sum((L.T*L for L in branches), abort.T*abort), I)
        channel = sum((L*rho*L.T for L in branches), abort*rho*abort.T)
        assert eq(channel, c**(2*K)*rho+(1-c**(2*K))*pinch)
        # The abort branch preserves the COMPLETE input, including references.
        assert eq(abort*rho*abort.T, c**(2*K)*rho)
        for sign, Q in enumerate(P):
            grouped = sum((branches[2*n+sign]*rho*branches[2*n+sign].T
                           for n in range(K)), sp.zeros(2))
            assert eq(grouped, (1-c**(2*K))*Q*rho*Q)

    # An explicit entangled old-reference test: abort is not a replacement state.
    bell = sp.Matrix((1, 0, 0, 1))/sp.sqrt(2)
    Omega = bell*bell.T
    Qref = tuple(sp.kronecker_product(Q, I) for Q in P)
    pinched_Omega = sum((Q*Omega*Q for Q in Qref), sp.zeros(4))
    reference_drift = Omega-pinched_Omega
    assert sorted(reference_drift.eigenvals().items(), key=lambda x: x[0]) == [
        (-sp.Rational(1, 2), 1), (sp.Integer(0), 2), (sp.Rational(1, 2), 1)]
    # Thus the unflagged Bell-state trace distance is c^(2K)/2.
    # With an explicit abort flag, the cap-vs-eventual instrument difference
    # has negative bright blocks -r^K Q Omega Q and positive abort r^K Omega.
    # Their orthogonal-flag trace norms sum to 2r^K for EVERY normalized Omega:
    # half diamond distance is exactly r^K (after time is marginalised).
    assert sp.trace(Omega)+sum(sp.trace(Q*Omega*Q) for Q in Qref) == 2

    u = sp.symbols('u', positive=True, real=True)
    r = 1-u
    h = lambda q: -q*sp.log(q)-(1-q)*sp.log(1-q)

    def log_normal(x):
        # Domain: 0<u<1, positive rational eigenvalues; structural zeros omitted.
        return sp.simplify(sp.expand(sp.expand_log(x, force=True)))

    lam = (sp.Rational(1, 2)+sp.sqrt(5)/10,
           sp.Rational(1, 2)-sp.sqrt(5)/10)
    Srho = -sum(q*sp.log(q) for q in lam)
    t = sp.Rational(3, 5)
    DeltaS = h(t)-Srho
    derivative_records = []
    for K in caps:
        exit_weights = tuple(u*r**(n-1) for n in range(1, K+1))
        abort_weight = r**K
        w = 1-r**K
        T = sum(r**j for j in range(K))
        assert sp.simplify(T-w/u) == 0
        assert sp.simplify(sum(exit_weights)+abort_weight-1) == 0
        # Complete capped prefix: status distinguishes exit at K from abort at K.
        Hprefix = -sum(q*sp.log(q) for q in exit_weights)
        Hprefix -= abort_weight*sp.log(abort_weight)
        assert log_normal(Hprefix-T*h(u)) == 0
        # All actual quantum eigenbranches: two abort eigenvalues and two
        # rank-one bright eigenvalues per n. Other branch eigenvalues are zero.
        nonzero = tuple(abort_weight*q for q in lam)
        nonzero += tuple(q*a for q in exit_weights for a in (t, 1-t))
        Sgamma = -sum(q*sp.log(q) for q in nonzero)
        Info = Sgamma-Srho
        claimed = T*h(u)+w*DeltaS
        assert log_normal(Info-claimed) == 0
        Tp = sp.diff(T, u)
        wp = K*r**(K-1)
        derivative = Tp*h(u)+T*sp.log(r/u)+wp*DeltaS
        assert log_normal(sp.diff(Info, u)-derivative) == 0
        # Actual positive elapsed-stage count can have a NEGATIVE source.
        assert sp.expand(Tp+sum(j*r**(j-1) for j in range(1, K))) == 0
        derivative_records.append({'K': K, 'T': str(sp.expand(T)),
                                   'T_prime': str(sp.expand(Tp))})

    # General cap induction: no enumeration of a 128^K tree is needed.
    k = sp.symbols('k', positive=True, integer=True)
    Tk = (1-r**k)/u
    assert sp.simplify((1-r**(k+1))/u-(1+r*Tk)) == 0
    # H_0=0 and H_(K+1)=h(u)+rH_K imply H_K=T_K h(u).

    # Generic ACTUAL entering-attempt operator and ADDITIONAL terminal WORK.
    # Components must have disjoint ledger ownership: an exit charge already
    # included in Catt is not charged again through Wplus/Wminus.
    # These rational observables are DIAGNOSTIC supplied operands, not tariffs
    # attributed to the native factory. They do not commute with the input.
    Catt = sp.Matrix(((2, sp.Rational(1, 3)), (sp.Rational(1, 3), 1)))
    Wplus = sp.Matrix(((3, sp.Rational(1, 4)), (sp.Rational(1, 4), 2)))
    Wminus = sp.Matrix(((1, -sp.Rational(1, 5)), (-sp.Rational(1, 5), 4)))
    Wabort = sp.Matrix(((5, sp.Rational(1, 7)), (sp.Rational(1, 7), 6)))
    Gbright = P[0]*Wplus*P[0]+P[1]*Wminus*P[1]
    for K in caps:
        T = sum(r**j for j in range(K))
        w = 1-r**K
        direct = sum((r**j*Catt for j in range(K)), sp.zeros(2))
        direct += sum((u*r**j*Gbright for j in range(K)), sp.zeros(2))
        direct += r**K*Wabort
        compact = T*Catt+w*Gbright+r**K*Wabort
        assert all(sp.simplify(x) == 0 for x in direct-compact)
        derivative = sp.diff(T, u)*Catt+K*r**(K-1)*(Gbright-Wabort)
        assert all(sp.simplify(x) == 0 for x in sp.diff(compact, u)-derivative)
        # Independent input-preparation reaction is not removed.
        drho = sp.Matrix(((0, sp.Rational(1, 10)), (sp.Rational(1, 10), 0)))
        assert sp.simplify(sp.trace(drho*compact)) != 0

    # Non-scalar quiet variant: the owned operator order must be retained.
    # This is a rational matrix diagnostic, not a new native-angle realization.
    B = sp.diag(sp.Rational(3, 5), sp.Rational(4, 5))
    Lbright = (-sp.Rational(4, 5)*P[0], -sp.Rational(3, 5)*P[1])
    assert Catt*B != B*Catt
    K = 3
    effects = sum(((L*B**j).T*(L*B**j)
                   for j in range(K) for L in Lbright), (B**K).T*B**K)
    assert effects == I
    tvar = sp.symbols('tvar', real=True)
    Bt = B+tvar*sp.diag(1, -1)
    entered_cost = sum((Bt**j*Catt*Bt**j for j in range(K)), sp.zeros(2))
    dB = sp.diag(1, -1)

    def d_power(j):
        return sum((B**m*dB*B**(j-1-m) for m in range(j)), sp.zeros(2))

    ordered_source = sum((d_power(j)*Catt*B**j+B**j*Catt*d_power(j)
                          for j in range(K)), sp.zeros(2))
    assert sp.diff(entered_cost, tvar).subs(tvar, 0) == ordered_source

    # Mark every ACTUALLY executed attempt; the cap abort is still present.
    x = sp.symbols('x', positive=True, real=True)
    for K in caps:
        Ex = u*x*sum((r*x)**j for j in range(K))
        complete = Ex+(r*x)**K
        assert sp.simplify(complete.subs(x, 1)-1) == 0
        assert sp.simplify(Ex.subs(x, 1)-(1-r**K)) == 0
        assert sp.simplify(sp.diff(complete, x).subs(x, 1)
                           -sum(r**j for j in range(K))) == 0
    Einf = u*x/(1-r*x)
    assert sp.simplify(sp.diff(Einf, u)-x*(1-x)/(1-r*x)**2) == 0
    assert sp.simplify(sp.diff(Einf, x).subs(x, 1)-1/u) == 0
    assert sp.simplify(Einf.subs(x, 1)-1) == 0
    assert sp.simplify(Einf*(1-x)/(x*(1-Einf))-u) == 0

    # Uncapped waiting-time Cost-Info: a REAL quiet charge is required.
    ell, k0, kB, DS = sp.symbols('ell k0 kB DS', real=True)
    Cinf = k0*r/u+kB
    Iinf = h(u)/u+DS
    derivative_price = sp.diff(ell*Cinf-Iinf, u)
    assert log_normal(derivative_price+(ell*k0+sp.log(r))/u**2) == 0
    pp = sp.symbols('pp', positive=True)
    # At native r=p^6, ell=-log p, cancellation of THIS component asks k0=6.
    assert sp.expand_log(-6*sp.log(pp)+sp.log(pp**6), force=True) == 0

    return {
        'owner_consumed': 'STOPPED_CLOCK_SOURCE retained isometry/marked-cost/source',
        'changed_input': 'native scalar quiet cI; bright -sP+/-',
        'caps_checked_exactly': caps,
        'TP_cap_abort_retained': True,
        'abort_normalized_DATA_old_reference_state': 'exactly the incoming Omega',
        'coarse_cap_channel': 'r^K id+(1-r^K)Pinch_H',
        'coarse_flagged_cap_vs_eventual_half_diamond': 'exactly r^K',
        'conditional_EXIT_Luders': 'exact at every cap; not claimed as a free postselection',
        'complete_capped_prefix_entropy': 'T_K*h(u), includes exit/abort status at time K',
        'complete_CQ_Info': 'T_K*h(u)+(1-r^K)*DeltaS_H',
        'Info_full_source': 'DT_K*h(u)+T_K*log((1-u)/u)*Du+Dw*DeltaS_H+w*DDeltaS_H; keep initial entropy and input/H motion',
        'full_cost_kernel': 'Cinit+sum B^j Catt B^j+sum L_n,b^dag Wb L_n,b+B^K Wabort B^K+Ccontroller',
        'scalar_cost_kernel': 'Cinit+T_K*Catt+(1-r^K)*Gbright+r^K*Wabort+Ccontroller',
        'cost_source_keeps': 'operator derivatives, controller, input Tr(DOmega*Ceff), initial preparation',
        'expected_attempts_and_duration_sources': derivative_records,
        'raw_elapsed_stages': 'actual stages_per_attempt*T_K plus actual controller/record stages',
        'expected_duration_requires_actually_stopped_controller': True,
        'unrolled_fixed_cap_raw_clock_not_replaced_by_expected_time': True,
        'uncapped_Info': 'h(u)/u+DeltaS_H',
        'uncapped_quiet_charge_Cost_minus_Info_source': '-(ell*k0+log(1-u))/u^2 + actual controller source',
        'native_quiet_charge_stationarity_test': 'k0=6 REQUIRED for stated component, NOT assigned from p^6',
        'marked_exit_operator': 'u*x*(1-(r*x)^K)/(1-r*x) I; uncap u*x/(1-r*x) I',
        'marked_cap_abort_operator': '(r*x)^K I',
        'unmarked_eventual_exit_field_source': 'zero; marked waiting operator has nonzero u-source',
        'physical_controller_admission_proved': False,
        'new_Bellman_or_action_proposed': False,
        'actual_native_tariff_provided': False,
        'old_Book_clock_or_GR_source_transferred': False,
        'old_fixture_or_root_replayed': False,
        'all_evidence_is_exact': True,
    }

def run_native_stop_consumers():
    import sympy as sp
    p=ne.P;a=ne.A;c=p**3;u0=4*p**3;r0=p**6
    assert ne.exact_matrix_equal(sp.Matrix([[u0+r0]]),sp.ones(1))
    assert (sp.Rational(2,3)-p).is_positive is True
    assert sp.Rational(2,3)**6<sp.Rational(1,10)
    assert (1-2*p*p).is_positive is True # 2 log(phi)>log2, no fair coin used.
    # Same-H rounds after bright preserve the COMPLETE old reference state.
    P0=sp.diag(1,0);P1=sp.diag(0,1);I=sp.eye(2)
    old=sp.Matrix([[sp.Rational(3,5),sp.Rational(1,5)],[sp.Rational(1,5),sp.Rational(2,5)]])
    sigma=sp.kronecker_product(P0,old)
    bright=2*a*p*sp.kronecker_product(P0,I)
    wrong=2*a*p*sp.kronecker_product(P1,I)
    assert ne.exact_matrix_equal(bright*sigma*bright.H,u0*sigma)
    assert wrong*sigma*wrong.H==sp.zeros(4)
    assert ne.exact_matrix_equal((c*sp.eye(4))*sigma*(c*sp.eye(4)),r0*sigma)
    # Exact cap VALUE and SOURCE boundary; no discarded abort-price term.
    u=sp.symbols('u',positive=True,real=True);r=1-u
    ell,k0,kB,kA,DS=sp.symbols('ell k0 kB kA DS',real=True)
    h=-u*sp.log(u)-r*sp.log(r)
    Cinf=k0*r/u+kB;Iinf=h/u+DS;Qinf=ell*Cinf-Iinf
    for K in (1,2,3,5):
        exit=1-r**K;T=sum(r**j for j in range(K))
        Ccap=k0*r*T+kB*exit+kA*r**K
        Icap=T*h+exit*DS
        Qcap=ell*Ccap-Icap
        assert sp.simplify(Qcap-exit*Qinf-ell*r**K*kA)==0
        derivative=exit*sp.diff(Qinf,u)+K*r**(K-1)*(Qinf-ell*kA)
        assert sp.simplify(sp.diff(Qcap,u)-derivative)==0
        # Per-executed-attempt native inventory component, not physicalCost.
        assert sp.simplify((r*98*T+exit*98)-98*T)==0
    ET3=1+r0+r0*r0
    Dstage3=-98*(1+2*r0)
    assert Dstage3.is_negative is True
    # Common full time/sign/abort outputs: identical mass through cap;
    # cap-abort and infinite tail are orthogonal flags, each trace r^K.
    # Thus diamond distance2r^K. This is not a survival-normalized channel.
    return {
        'native_attempt_inventory':{'G':4,'CX':74,'SourceI':20,'raw_stages':98},
        'native_stop_probability':str(sp.N(u0,24)),
        'native_quiet_probability':str(sp.N(r0,24)),
        'expected_primitive_inventory':'(4G,74CX,20SourceI)*T_K + actual controller/readout/closing ledger',
        'expected_native_attempts_cap3':str(sp.N(ET3,24)),
        'expected_raw_attempt_stages_cap3':str(sp.N(98*ET3,24)),
        'raw_attempt_stage_source_cap3':str(sp.N(Dstage3,24)),
        'expected_attempts_uncapped':str(sp.N(1/u0,24)),
        'common_full_archive_cap_vs_infinite_diamond':'exactly2*r^K including abort and all time/sign labels',
        'cap10_normalized_trace_error_strict':'<1e-10; r<1/10; not a price-source bound',

"""Changed stopped-tree Book application; old checkers are never executed.

import sys

import json
from pathlib import Path

import sympy as S
import numpy as np

PRIMARY = Path('02_REGISTRY/research/A4D_NONVACUUM_SAME_REPRESENTATIVE_PAID_SOURCE_RESIDUAL_2026_10_20.md').resolve()

def raw_tree(cap, stages):
    assert type(cap) is int and cap >= 1 and type(stages) is int and stages >= 1
    nodes = [('ROOT', 0, None)]
    edges, terminal, forks = [], [], []
    current = 0
    for attempt in range(1, cap + 1):
        for stage in range(stages):
            child = len(nodes)
            nodes.append(('GATE', attempt, stage))
            edges.append((current, child, 'gate', attempt, stage))
            current = child
        forks.append(current)
        for label in range(4):
            child = len(nodes)
            nodes.append(('READ', attempt, label))
            edges.append((current, child, 'read', attempt, label))
            if label == 0 and attempt < cap:
                next_live = child
            else:
                terminal.append(child)
        if attempt < cap:
            current = next_live
    return nodes, edges, terminal, forks


def validate_native_tree():
    built = owned.build_attempt()  # definitions-only reuse; no old fixture suite
    gates = built['execution'].gates
    assert len(gates) == 98
    out = []
    for cap in (1, 2, 3, 5):
        nodes, edges, terminal, forks = raw_tree(cap, 98)
        assert len(nodes) == 102*cap + 1 and len(edges) == 102*cap
        assert len(terminal) == 3*cap + 1 and len(forks) == cap
        incoming = [0]*len(nodes)
        outgoing = [[] for _ in nodes]
        depth = [0]*len(nodes)
        for parent, child, kind, attempt, value in edges:
            assert parent < child
            incoming[child] += 1
            outgoing[parent].append((kind, value))
            depth[child] = depth[parent] + 1
        assert incoming == [0] + [1]*(len(nodes)-1)
        assert max(depth) == 99*cap
        assert [v for v in range(len(nodes)) if not outgoing[v]] == terminal
        assert sum(bool(x) for x in outgoing) == 99*cap
        assert all(len(x) == 1 or x == [('read', h) for h in range(4)]
                   for x in outgoing if x)
        sealed, slots = set(), []
        for attempt in range(1, cap+1):
            if attempt == 1:
                src, arch = (1, 2), (10, 11)
            else:
                start = 12 + 4*(attempt-2)
                src, arch = (start, start+1), (start+2, start+3)
            mapping = {1: src[0], 2: src[1], 10: arch[0], 11: arch[1]}
            mapped = tuple(owned.ne.Gate(g.op, tuple(mapping.get(w, w) for w in g.wires))
                           for g in gates)
            assert all(not sealed.intersection(g.wires) for g in mapped)
            assert all(9 not in g.wires for g in mapped)
            assert all(g.wires == (0,) for g in mapped if g.op == 'G')
            assert all(g.wires == (0, 7, 8) for g in mapped if g.op == 'SourceI')
            sealed.update(src + arch)
            slots.append((src, arch))
        world_fibre = 8192*16**cap
        nv, ne = len(nodes), len(edges)
        n0, n1 = 33*nv*world_fibre, (359*nv + 33*ne)*world_fibre
        assert n1 - n0 == (359*nv - 33)*world_fibre
        out.append({'cap': cap, 'vertices': nv, 'edges': ne,
                    'terminal_including_faults': len(terminal),
                    'raw_path_max_depth': max(depth), 'fresh_slots': slots,
                    'n0': n0, 'n1': n1, 'index': n1-n0})
    return out


R = S.Rational
sp = lambda x: S.SparseMatrix(x)
eye = lambda n: S.MutableSparseMatrix.eye(n)
zero = lambda m, n: S.MutableSparseMatrix(m, n, {})
kron = lambda *x: sp(S.kronecker_product(*x))


def block_embed(matrix, row, col, rows, cols):
    m, n = matrix.shape
    return S.MutableSparseMatrix(rows*m, cols*n,
        {(row*m+i, col*n+j): v for (i, j), v in matrix.todok().items()})


def fixture():
    # A SMALL arbitrary full-world cochain, not the actual98 native attempt:
    # scene path3 x archive4 x DATA2. All24 input columns are kept, including
    # arbitrary archive/fault inputs. One reused toy archive suffices to test
    # the algebra; actual fresh native slots are checked separately above.
    cap, stages, d = 2, 2, 24
    nodes, edges, leaves, forks = raw_tree(cap, stages)
    nv = len(nodes)
    c, s, u = R(4, 5), R(3, 5), R(9, 25)
    dc, ds = -1/(2*c), 1/(2*s)
    e4 = eye(4)
    pp, pm = sp(S.diag(1, 0)), sp(S.diag(0, 1))
    ket0 = sp(S.Matrix([1, 0, 0, 0]))
    ket1 = sp(S.Matrix([0, 1, 0, 0]))
    ket2 = sp(S.Matrix([0, 0, 1, 0]))
    inp = kron(ket0, eye(2))
    bright = kron(ket1, pm) + kron(ket2, pp)
    P, Q = inp*inp.T, bright*bright.T
    A = eye(8) - P-Q + c*(P-Q) - s*(bright*inp.T + inp*bright.T)
    DA = dc*(P-Q) - ds*(bright*inp.T + inp*bright.T)
    assert A.T*A == eye(8)
    rot = sp(S.Matrix([[c, -s, 0], [s, c, 0], [0, 0, 1]]))
    drot = sp(S.Matrix([[dc, -ds, 0], [ds, dc, 0], [0, 0, 0]]))
    g0 = kron(rot, e4, pp) + kron(eye(3), e4, pm)
    dg0 = kron(drot, e4, pp)
    g1 = kron(eye(3), A)*g0.T
    dg1 = kron(eye(3), DA)*g0.T + kron(eye(3), A)*dg0.T
    # Another variation changes ONLY intermediate scene routing, holding
    # endpoint A/c/u and all terminal Kraus blocks fixed.
    hgen = sp(S.Matrix([[0, -1, 0], [1, 0, 0], [0, 0, 0]]))
    dg0_route = kron(hgen*rot, e4, pp)
    dg1_route = kron(eye(3), A)*dg0_route.T
    proj = [kron(eye(3), sp(S.diag(*[int(k == h) for k in range(4)])), eye(2))
            for h in range(4)]
    assert sum(proj, zero(d,d)) == eye(d)
    assert all(x*x == x and x.T == x for x in proj)
    Dscene = sp(S.diag(1, 2, 1))
    assert kron(Dscene, eye(8))*g0 != g0*kron(Dscene, eye(8))
    L, DL, DL_route, paths = {}, {}, {}, [eye(d)] + [None]*(nv-1)
    for parent, child, kind, _, value in edges:
        v = (g0, g1)[value] if kind == 'gate' else proj[value]
        dv = (dg0, dg1)[value] if kind == 'gate' else zero(d,d)
        dr = (dg0_route, dg1_route)[value] if kind == 'gate' else zero(d,d)
        L[child], DL[child], DL_route[child] = v, dv, dr
        paths[child] = v*paths[parent]
    for vertex in range(nv):
        outgoing = [L[ch].T*L[ch] for pa, ch, *_ in edges if pa == vertex]
        if outgoing:
            assert sum(outgoing, zero(d,d)) == eye(d)
    # Leaf isometry on EVERY full WORLD column. No compression to input.
    J = block_embed(eye(d), 0, 0, nv, 1)
    V = sum((block_embed(paths[v], v, 0, nv, 1) for v in leaves), zero(nv*d, d))
    assert V.T*V == eye(d) and J.T*V == zero(d,d)
    Us = eye(nv*d) - J*J.T - V*V.T + V*J.T + J*V.T
    assert Us.T == Us and Us*Us == eye(nv*d) and Us*J == V
    abort = next(i for i in leaves if nodes[i] == ('READ', cap, 0))
    perm = eye(nv)
    perm[0,0] = perm[abort,abort] = 0
    perm[0,abort] = perm[abort,0] = 1
    recode = kron(perm, eye(d))
    assert recode.T*recode == eye(nv*d)
    # Same complete initial cut; coherent scene input makes R nonzero/nonunit.
    xi = sp(S.Matrix([R(3,5), R(4,5), 0]))
    j = kron(xi, inp)
    assert j.T*j == eye(2)
    jc = J*j
    assert jc.T*Us*jc == zero(2,2)
    assert jc.T*recode*Us*jc == c**cap*eye(2)
    assert (recode*Us).T*(recode*Us) == eye(nv*d)
    for v in leaves:
        if nodes[v][2] == 3:
            assert paths[v]*j == zero(d,2) and L[v] != zero(d,d)
    raw_gram = sum((v.T*v for v in paths), zero(d,d))
    TK = 1 + c*c
    assert j.T*raw_gram*j == (1+(stages+1)*TK)*eye(2)
    # Direct incidence rows, full scene/work columns, and independent transfer
    # expression must agree BEFORE any exponentials/numerical approximation.
    bscene = sp(S.Matrix([[-1, 1, 0], [0, -1, 1]]))
    A_scene = Dscene - bscene.T*bscene
    nr_scene = nv*2*8
    nr = nr_scene + len(edges)*d
    dr, ddr, ddr_route = zero(nr,nv*d), zero(nr,nv*d), zero(nr,nv*d)
    for v in range(nv):
        for (i,k), val in kron(bscene, eye(8)).todok().items():
            dr[v*16+i, v*d+k] = val
    T, DT, DT_route = zero(nv*d,nv*d), zero(nv*d,nv*d), zero(nv*d,nv*d)
    for n, (pa,ch,*_) in enumerate(edges):
        start = nr_scene+n*d
        for (i,k), val in L[ch].todok().items():
            dr[start+i,pa*d+k] = -val
        for i in range(d):
            dr[start+i,ch*d+i] = 1
        for deriv, target in ((DL,ddr),(DL_route,ddr_route)):
            for (i,k), val in deriv[ch].todok().items():
                target[start+i,pa*d+k] = -val
        T += block_embed(L[ch],ch,pa,nv,nv)
        DT += block_embed(DL[ch],ch,pa,nv,nv)
        DT_route += block_embed(DL_route[ch],ch,pa,nv,nv)
    delta = [1 if v == 0 or v in leaves else 2 for v in range(nv)]
    D = sp(S.diag(*[int(Dscene[i//8,i//8])+delta[v]
                    for v in range(nv) for i in range(d)]))
    As = kron(eye(nv), A_scene, eye(8))
    assert dr.T*dr == D-As-T-T.T
    DAraw = dr.T*ddr + ddr.T*dr
    DAr = dr.T*ddr_route + ddr_route.T*dr
    assert DAraw == -DT-DT.T and DAr == -DT_route-DT_route.T
    # Normalized history is R^-1 times raw path, not the same path.
    norm_gram = sum((paths[v].T*kron(Dscene+delta[v]*eye(3),eye(8))*paths[v]
                     for v in range(nv)),zero(d,d))
    input_norm_gram = j.T*norm_gram*j
    assert input_norm_gram != S.trace(input_norm_gram)/2*eye(2)
    assert input_norm_gram != j.T*raw_gram*j
    assert kron(bscene,eye(8))*j != zero(16,2)  # Not full-Hodge harmonic.
    df = np.array(D.diagonal(), dtype=float).ravel()
    rvv = 1/np.sqrt(df)
    rr = np.diag(rvv)
    raw_float = np.array(dr, dtype=float)
    Delta = rvv[:,None]*np.array(dr.T*dr,dtype=float)*rvv[None,:]
    DDelta = rvv[:,None]*np.array(DAraw,dtype=float)*rvv[None,:]
    DDelta_route = rvv[:,None]*np.array(DAr,dtype=float)*rvv[None,:]
    vals, vecs = np.linalg.eigh(Delta)
    assert vals.min() > -2e-12 and vals.max() <= 2+2e-12
    beta = 0.7
    index = nr - nv*d
    expvals = np.exp(-beta*vals)
    Z = 2*expvals.sum()+index
    rhoeff = np.einsum('ik,jk->ij',vecs*(2*expvals/Z),vecs,optimize=False)
    assert np.isfinite(rhoeff).all() and np.isfinite(Delta).all()
    source = -np.einsum('ij,ji->',rhoeff,DDelta,optimize=False)
    source_transfer = 2*np.einsum('ij,ji->',rvv[:,None]*rhoeff*rvv[None,:],
                                   np.array(DT,dtype=float),optimize=False)
    route_source = -np.einsum('ij,ji->',rhoeff,DDelta_route,optimize=False)
    assert abs(route_source) > 1e-6
    assert abs(source-source_transfer) < 2e-12
    def heat_linear(eps):
        # Only this finite-difference fixture linearizes the raw d at the base.
        mat = raw_float + eps*np.array(ddr,dtype=float)
        gram = np.einsum('ki,kj->ij',mat,mat,optimize=False)
        lam = np.linalg.eigvalsh(rvv[:,None]*gram*rvv[None,:])
        return np.log(2*np.exp(-beta*lam).sum()+index)/beta
    eps = 1e-5
    derivative = (heat_linear(eps)-heat_linear(-eps))/(2*eps)
    assert abs(derivative-source) < 2e-8
    # Same root/leaves diagonal; no two terminal-support nodes adjacent.
    assert all(not(pa in leaves and ch in leaves) for pa,ch,*_ in edges)
    rho_in = np.array(j*j.T/2,dtype=float)
    rv = np.einsum('ij,ji->',np.array((J*j)*(J*j).T/2,dtype=float),Delta,optimize=False)
    coherent = np.array((V*j)*(V*j).T/2,dtype=float)
    cq = sum((np.array(block_embed(paths[v]*j,v,0,nv,1)*
                        block_embed(paths[v]*j,v,0,nv,1).T/2,dtype=float)
              for v in leaves),np.zeros((nv*d,nv*d)))
    rcoh = np.einsum('ij,ji->',coherent,Delta,optimize=False)
    rcq = np.einsum('ij,ji->',cq,Delta,optimize=False)
    assert max(abs(rv-rcoh),abs(rv-rcq)) < 2e-12
    # Feedback sign exact on the same ret-cut; eta=1-zeta, no Golden-a clash.
    zeta = R(2,5)
    dJdu = 2*zeta*cap*(c*c)**(cap-1)/(1-zeta+zeta*(c*c)**cap)
    assert dJdu > 0
    return {'small_fixture_only': True, 'cap':cap, 'raw_stages_per_attempt':stages,
        'world_full_dimension':d, 'vertices':nv, 'edges':len(edges),
        'n0':nv*d,'n1':nr,'index':index, 'min_max_Delta':(float(vals.min()),float(vals.max())),
        'full_column_isometry_and_completion_exact':True,
        'fault_path_zero_on_input_projector_nonzero_on_full_world':True,
        'cold_forward':0,'cold_recode':str(c**cap),
        'history_raw_input_gram':str(1+(stages+1)*TK),
        'normalization_Gram_nonscalar_on_input':str(input_norm_gram), 'heat_source':float(source),
        'heat_source_finite_difference':float(derivative),
        'heat_source_tolerance':2e-8,'fixed_endpoint_routing_heat_source':float(route_source),
        'Rayleigh_birth_coherent_CQ':(float(rv),float(rcoh),float(rcq)),
        'positive_same_cut_J_u':str(dJdu),
        'huge_native_heat_or_physical_controller_emitted':False}


if __name__ == '__main__':
    assert __debug__, 'run this new exact checker with assertions enabled'
    print(json.dumps({'owned_7br_code_bytes':len(OLD),
        'owned_7br_code_sha256':hashlib.sha256(OLD).hexdigest(),
        'definitions_only_prefix_bytes':len(PREFIX.encode()),
        'definitions_only_prefix_sha256':hashlib.sha256(PREFIX.encode()).hexdigest(),
        'native_tree_structure':validate_native_tree(),
        'changed_full_column_fixture':fixture(),
        'old_checkers_or_matrix_suites_executed':False},indent=2))
```

or a huge actual14-qubit matrix.  No price is assigned to any primitive G.

import sys
sys.dont_write_bytecode = True
from pathlib import Path
import hashlib
import json
import types


PRIMARY = Path('02_REGISTRY/research/A4D_NONVACUUM_SAME_REPRESENTATIVE_PAID_SOURCE_RESIDUAL_2026_10_20.md').resolve()
STOP_CODE_BYTES = 25785
STOP_CODE_SHA256 = '83ee489241b4262b896f43c7e78e9c90eaabb1bb0239a65828b19df86febf3c3'
STOP_MATH_MARKER = '"""Exact scalar-quiet specialization of the OWNED first-event/cap calculus.'


def load_owned_definitions():
    """Load 7br helpers only; its nested 7bp/7bo imports also exclude mathematics."""
    source = PRIMARY.read_text(encoding='utf-8')
    section = source.index('## 7br. ')
    a = source.index('```python\n', section) + len('```python\n')
    b = source.index('\n```', a)
    code = source[a:b].encode('utf-8')
    if len(code) != STOP_CODE_BYTES or hashlib.sha256(code).hexdigest() != STOP_CODE_SHA256:
        raise RuntimeError('frozen 7br fenced code pin changed')
    text = code.decode('utf-8')
    if STOP_MATH_MARKER not in text:
        raise RuntimeError('7br definitions/mathematics separator absent')
    prefix = text.split(STOP_MATH_MARKER, 1)[0]
    owner = types.ModuleType('_d0_birth_monitor_owned_attempt')
    owner.__file__ = str(PRIMARY)
    sys.modules[owner.__name__] = owner
    exec(compile(prefix, str(PRIMARY), 'exec'), owner.__dict__)
    owner.MONITOR_PROVENANCE = {
        'primary_source_path': str(PRIMARY),
        '7br_fenced_code_bytes': len(code),
        '7br_fenced_code_sha256': hashlib.sha256(code).hexdigest(),
        '7br_definitions_prefix_bytes': len(prefix.encode('utf-8')),
        '7br_definitions_prefix_sha256': hashlib.sha256(prefix.encode('utf-8')).hexdigest(),
        'nested_7bp_7bo_provenance': owner.owned.owned.PROVENANCE,
        'old_math_and_matrix_fixtures_executed': False,
    }
    return owner


def build_native_variant(owner):
    """The ACTUAL14-wire word: Dterm;A;Cbirth;M;A_inverse;Dterm."""
    c = owner.Compiler(14, 0, (7, 8), (9,))
    parts = owner.owned.cold_cell(c, (1, 2), 4, c.seq())
    terminal_copy = c.seq(c.cx(1, 10), c.cx(2, 11))

    return {'compiler': c, 'parts': parts, 'word': word,
            'execution': execution, 'terminal_copy': terminal_copy,
            'birth_copy': birth_copy}


def native_inventory_report(owner):
    built = build_native_variant(owner)
    c, word, e = built['compiler'], built['word'], built['execution']
    ne = owner.ne
    counts = c.counts(word).as_dict()
    assert counts == {'G': 4, 'CX': 76, 'SourceI': 20,

    assert iv.cut_rank == 128 and iv.full_dimension == 16384
    leaves = c._leaves(word, tuple(range(14)))
    assert all(g.wires == (0,) for g in leaves if g.op == 'G')
    assert all(g.wires == (0, 7, 8) for g in leaves if g.op == 'SourceI')
    assert all(9 not in g.wires for g in leaves)
    assert all(set(g.wires).isdisjoint((7, 8)) for g in leaves if g.op != 'SourceI')
    for source, archive in ((1, 10), (2, 11)):

            ne.Gate('CX', (source, archive)),) * 2
    for source, archive in ((1, 12), (2, 13)):
        assert tuple(g for g in e.gates if archive in g.wires) == (
            ne.Gate('CX', (source, archive)),)
    inverse = tuple(c.iter_raw(c.inv(word)))
    assert inverse == ne.inverse_word(e, max_qubits=14,
                                      max_expanded_stages=len(inverse))
    assert len(inverse) == 156
    assert c.counts(c.inv(word)).as_dict() == {
        'G': 4, 'CX': 76, 'SourceI': 76,
        'N': 156, 'g_port': 4, 'g_off': 0}
    return {
        'layout': {'qubits': 14, 'physical_port': 0, 'SOURCE': (1, 2),
                   'DATA_roles': (3, 4, 5, 6), 'H': 'Z_role1 on wire4',
                   'phase_Spin': (7, 8), 'immutable_oldRIGHT': (9,),
                   'terminal_archive': (10, 11), 'BIRTH_archive': (12, 13),
                   'blank_wires': e.blank_wires, 'unknown_wires': iv.unknown_wires},
        'native_counts': counts,
        'raw_inverse_counts': c.counts(c.inv(word)).as_dict(),
        'raw_inverse_leafwise_equals_owned': True,
        'unique_leaf_validation': c.validate(word),
        'input_rank_one_old_qubit': iv.cut_rank,
        'true_oldRIGHT128_input_rank': 8192,
        'true_oldRIGHT128_active_dimension': 2*4*4*4*16*4*128,
        'true_oldRIGHT128_physical33_dimension': 33*4*4*4*16*4*128,
        'actual14_qubit_matrix_allocated': False,
        'unbalanced_BIRTH_copy_was_uncomputed': False,
        'old_completed_dark_identity_inherited': False,
        'all_dark_and_unprepared_columns_must_be_retained': True,
        'nonterminal_readout_or_runtime_controller_compiled': False,
        'native_G_or_return_cost_tariff_assigned': False,
    }


def run_rational_fixture():
    """Independent NEW SOURCE4 x BIRTH4 x TERMINAL4 x DATA2 all128 fixture."""
    import sympy as sp
    R = sp.Rational
    sparse = sp.MutableSparseMatrix
    I2, I4, I128 = sparse.eye(2), sparse.eye(4), sparse.eye(128)
    g = sparse([[R(4, 5), -R(3, 5)], [R(3, 5), R(4, 5)]])
    H = sparse([[R(3, 5), R(4, 5)], [R(4, 5), -R(3, 5)]])
    assert g.T*g == I2 and H.T == H and H*H == I2
    U_birth_blocks = (I2, H, -H, -I2)
    A = sparse(sp.kronecker_product(g, g, I4, I4, I2))
    M = sparse(sp.diag(*(sp.kronecker_product(I4, I4, U)
                         for U in U_birth_blocks)))

    def index(source, birth, terminal, data):
        return 2*(16*source+4*birth+terminal)+data

    Cbirth, Dterminal = sparse.zeros(128, 128), sparse.zeros(128, 128)
    for source in range(4):
        for birth in range(4):
            for terminal in range(4):
                for data in range(2):
                    col = index(source, birth, terminal, data)
                    Cbirth[index(source, birth ^ source, terminal, data), col] = 1
                    Dterminal[index(source, birth, terminal ^ source, data), col] = 1
    assert Cbirth*Cbirth == I128 and Dterminal*Dterminal == I128
    # Chronology Dterminal;A;Cbirth;M;A_inverse;Dterminal.
    full = Dterminal*A.T*M*Cbirth*A*Dterminal
    assert full.T*full == I128
    initial = sparse.zeros(128, 2)
    for data in range(2):
        initial[index(0, 0, 0, data), data] = 1
    output = full*initial
    assert output.T*output == I2
    # At this prepared input the terminal copy is EXACT: source == terminal.
    for source in range(4):
        for birth in range(4):
            for terminal in range(4):
                if source != terminal:
                    for data in range(2):
                        assert output[index(source, birth, terminal, data), :] == sp.zeros(1, 2)
    # Independent closed formula t_(birth,final) = psi_birth (g†)_(final,birth).
    q = R(9, 25)
    t = sparse([[1-q, -R(12, 25)], [q, R(12, 25)]])
    kraus, scalar_prob = {}, {}
    for birth in range(4):
        for terminal in range(4):
            b0, b1 = (birth >> 1) & 1, birth & 1
            h0, h1 = (terminal >> 1) & 1, terminal & 1
            coefficient = t[b0, h0]*t[b1, h1]
            extracted = sparse([[output[index(terminal, birth, terminal, data_out), data_in]
                                 for data_in in range(2)] for data_out in range(2)])
            assert extracted == coefficient*U_birth_blocks[birth]
            assert extracted.T*extracted == coefficient**2*I2
            kraus[(birth, terminal)] = extracted
            scalar_prob[(birth, terminal)] = coefficient**2
    assert sum((K.T*K for K in kraus.values()), sparse.zeros(2, 2)) == I2
    m, v = (1-q)**2+q**2, 2*q*(1-q)
    expected_h = (m*m, m*v, m*v, v*v)
    for terminal in range(4):
        effect = sum((kraus[(birth, terminal)].T*kraus[(birth, terminal)]
                      for birth in range(4)), sparse.zeros(2, 2))
        assert effect == expected_h[terminal]*I2
        assert sum(scalar_prob[(birth, terminal)] for birth in range(4)) == expected_h[terminal]
    assert expected_h[3] > 0  # The old structural-zero11 has been destroyed.

    def quiet(X):
        return sum((kraus[(birth, 0)]*X*kraus[(birth, 0)].T
                    for birth in range(4)), sparse.zeros(2, 2))

    alpha, beta = (1-q)**4+q**4, 2*q*q*(1-q)**2
    mu = alpha+beta
    assert mu == m*m
    # Check the CP map on ALL four matrix units, not just one input density.
    for i in range(2):
        for j in range(2):
            unit = sparse.zeros(2, 2)
            unit[i, j] = 1
            assert quiet(unit) == alpha*unit+beta*H*unit*H
    rho = sparse([[R(3, 5), R(1, 5)], [R(1, 5), R(2, 5)]])
    assert rho.trace() == 1 and rho.det() == R(1, 5)
    assert H*rho*H != rho and quiet(rho) != mu*rho
    assert quiet(rho).trace() == mu
    # The TRUE allblank return fixes BOTH archives, not just the final label.
    assert initial.T*full*initial == (1-q)**2*I2
    assert kraus[(0, 0)] == (1-q)**2*I2
    assert (1-q)**2 != 1-2*q
    return {
        'fixture_kind': 'new rational diagnostic; NOT a native Golden14 matrix',
        'full_world_dimension': 128,
        'layout': 'SOURCE4 x BIRTH4 x TERMINAL4 x DATA2',
        'g': [[str(x) for x in row] for row in g.tolist()],
        'non_diagonal_involution_H': [[str(x) for x in row] for row in H.tolist()],
        'q': str(q), 'all128_columns_unitary_exact': True,
        'all16_signed_Kraus_extracted_and_checked': True,
        'complete_TP': True,
        'terminal_SOURCE_and_archive_labels_equal': True,
        'every_fine_effect_scalar': True,
        'final_h_probabilities_DATAblind': [str(x) for x in expected_h],
        'final11_has_positive_probability': True,
        'quiet_CP_coefficients': {'identity': str(alpha), 'Ad_H': str(beta),
                                  'probability': str(mu)},
        'quiet_CP_checked_on_full_matrix_basis': True,
        'quiet_normalized_DATA_channel_is_identity': False,
        'true_BIRTHblank_terminalblank_corner': str((1-q)**2)+' I2',
        'no_Golden_tariff_or_controller_admission_inferred': True,
    }


def main():
    owner = load_owned_definitions()
    native = native_inventory_report(owner)
    fixture = run_rational_fixture()
    print('PROVENANCE', json.dumps(owner.MONITOR_PROVENANCE, sort_keys=True))
    print('ACTUAL_NATIVE100', json.dumps(native, sort_keys=True))
    print('NEW_RATIONAL128', json.dumps(fixture, sort_keys=True))
    print('PASS native100/inverse156 membership; NEW all128 rational instrument; no old math or huge native matrix')
    return native, fixture


"""New complete-price calculation for the monitored birth/terminal record."""
import json
import sympy as S
import numpy as np


def run_price_algebra():
    p = S.symbols('p', real=True)
    rem = lambda t: S.rem(S.expand(t),p*p+p-1,p)
    q = p*p
    assert rem((p*p+p**4)**2-5*p**6) == 0
    assert rem(p**4+p**8-3*p**6) == 0
    assert rem(1-4*p**3-p**6) == 0
    ccode, iphi = 4+2*p*p+4*p**3,4*(1+p*p)
    assert rem(ccode-iphi-2*p**5) == 0
    quiet_probs = ((2+p)/5,S.Rational(2,5),p*p/5)
    assert rem(sum(quiet_probs)-1) == 0
    quiet_cost = sum(pr*c for pr,c in zip(quiet_probs,(4,5,6)))
    assert rem(quiet_cost-(4+2*(1+p*p)/5)) == 0
    assert rem((quiet_cost-5)**2-S.Rational(1,5)) == 0
    # Native point lies1/2<p<2/3, fixing positive values and sqrt branch.
    assert S.Rational(1,2)**2+S.Rational(1,2)-1 < 0
    assert S.Rational(2,3)**2+S.Rational(2,3)-1 > 0
    assert rem((1-4*p*p)-(4*p-3)) == 0
    # An explicit FOUR-letter 0/10 writer, not an encoding cost inferred from
    # the100 quantum stages or silently attached to its pointer-bit storage.
    words = {}
    for b in range(4):
        for h in range(4):
            bits = ((b>>1)&1,b&1,(h>>1)&1,h&1)
            code = ''.join('10' if x else '0' for x in bits)
            cursor,decoded = 0,[]
            while cursor < len(code):
                if code[cursor] == '0':
                    decoded.append(0);cursor += 1
                else:
                    assert code[cursor:cursor+2] == '10'
                    decoded.append(1);cursor += 2
            assert tuple(decoded) == bits
            assert len(code) == 4+bin(b).count('1')+bin(h).count('1')
            words[b,h] = code
    assert len(set(words.values())) == 16
    # Reversible CLASSICAL report recoding e=h XOR b. Its conditional flip
    # bits are independentBern(q); a different written code has its ownprice.
    q0,q1=S.symbols('q0 q1',positive=True)
    weight_sum,delta_cost=S.Integer(0),S.Integer(0)
    for b in range(4):
        for h in range(4):
            e=h^b
            prob=S.Integer(1)
            for j,qj in enumerate((q0,q1)):
                bj,ej=(b>>j)&1,(e>>j)&1
                prob*=qj**(bj+ej)*(1-qj)**(2-bj-ej)
            weight_sum+=prob
            delta_cost+=prob*(4+bin(b).count('1')+bin(e).count('1'))
    assert S.simplify(weight_sum-1)==0
    assert S.simplify(delta_cost-(4+2*q0+2*q1))==0
    assert all(not(v.startswith(w)) for k,w in words.items() for j,v in words.items() if k != j)
    # Exact reference-sensitive abort disturbance after any finite retry count.
    Z = S.diag(1,-1)
    rho = S.Matrix([[S.Rational(1,2),S.Rational(1,2)],
                    [S.Rational(1,2),S.Rational(1,2)]])
    aborts = []
    for cap in (1,2,3,5):
        final = (rho+Z*rho*Z)/2+(rho-Z*rho*Z)/(2*5**cap)
        iterative = rho
        for _ in range(cap):
            iterative = S.Rational(3,5)*iterative+S.Rational(2,5)*Z*iterative*Z
        assert iterative == final and iterative != rho
        aborts.append({'cap':cap,'offdiagonal_factor':str(S.Rational(1,5**cap))})
    return {'native_quiet_probability':'5*p^6',
        'native_quiet_DATA_channel':'(3*rho+2*H*rho*H)/5',
        'native_quiet_conditional_fourletter_cost':'5-1/sqrt(5), not6',
        'native_literal_fourletter_Cost_minus_CQ_Info_phi':'2*p^5',
        'native_matched_angle_qi_source_of_that_component':'1-4*p^2',
        'fourletter_writer_words':list(words.values()),
        'abort_controls':aborts,
        'alternative_recode_b_e_native_code_component':'C_code=I_fine/ell onlyifthatdifferentwriterispaid',
        'writer_code_not_assigned_as_quantum_gate_tariff':True}


def run_complete_quantum_info():
    # Independent probabilities/matrices; no native word or old fixture replay.
    R = S.Rational
    G = S.Matrix([[R(4,5),-R(3,5)],[R(3,5),R(4,5)]])
    A = S.kronecker_product(G,G)
    H = S.Matrix([[R(3,5),R(4,5)],[R(4,5),-R(3,5)]])
    Ms = (S.eye(2),H,-H,-S.eye(2))
    # Full unknown DATA + old reference, with nonzero initial entropy.
    bell = S.Matrix([1,0,0,1])
    rho = R(2,3)*(bell*bell.T/2)+R(1,3)*S.eye(4)/4
    blocks, mean_cost, quiet_cost, quiet_prob = [],S.Integer(0),S.Integer(0),S.Integer(0)
    fine = []
    for b in range(4):
        for h in range(4):
            K = A[b,h]*A[b,0]*Ms[b]
            KR = S.kronecker_product(K,S.eye(2))
            block = KR*rho*KR.T
            prob = S.trace(block)
            assert prob > 0
            assert S.trace(block*block)/(prob*prob) == S.trace(rho*rho)
            length = 4+bin(b).count('1')+bin(h).count('1')
            mean_cost += prob*length
            if h == 0:
                quiet_cost += prob*length;quiet_prob += prob
            blocks.append(block)
            fine.append((K,prob,length,4+bin(b).count('1')+bin(h^b).count('1'),h))
    q = R(9,25)
    assert mean_cost == 4+6*q-4*q*q
    def entropy(M):
        eig = np.linalg.eigvalsh(np.array(M,dtype=float))
        return float(-sum(v*np.log(v) for v in eig if v > 1e-14))
    info = entropy(S.diag(*blocks))-entropy(rho)
    hq = -float(q)*np.log(float(q))-float(1-q)*np.log(float(1-q))
    assert abs(info-4*hq) < 2e-11
    assert sum((S.trace(x) for x in blocks),S.Integer(0)) == 1
    # Entire supplied first-nonzero-h/cap2 interface, including positive11,
    # allBIRTH records and16 abort leaves. No new native dispatcher is asserted.
    leaves = []
    for K1,w1,c1,e1,h1 in fine:
        if h1:
            leaves.append((K1,w1,c1,e1,False))
        else:
            for K2,w2,c2,e2,h2 in fine:
                leaves.append((K2*K1,w1*w2,c1+c2,e1+e2,h2==0))
    assert len(leaves) == 76 and sum(v[4] for v in leaves) == 16
    assert sum(v[1] for v in leaves) == 1
    mu = ((1-q)**2+q*q)**2
    assert sum(v[1] for v in leaves if v[4]) == mu*mu
    ccap = sum(v[1]*v[2] for v in leaves)
    ecap = sum(v[1]*v[3] for v in leaves)
    assert ccap == mean_cost*(1+mu)
    assert ecap == (4+4*q)*(1+mu)
    full_entropy = 0.0
    for K,w,_,_,_ in leaves:
        KR = S.kronecker_product(K,S.eye(2))
        block = KR*rho*KR.T
        assert S.trace(block) == w
        full_entropy += entropy(block)
    full_info = full_entropy-entropy(rho)
    assert abs(full_info-float(1+mu)*4*hq) < 2e-11
    return {'full_CQ_dimension':64,'DATA_old_dimension':4,
        'complete_fine_branches':16,'complete_CQ_gain':info,
        'chain_rule_gain':4*hq,'entropy_tolerance':2e-11,
        'rational_fourletter_mean_cost':str(mean_cost),
        'rational_conditional_quiet_mean_cost':str(quiet_cost/quiet_prob),
        'initial_entropy_retained':entropy(rho),
        'cap2_full_fine_leaves':76,'cap2_abort_leaves':16,
        'cap2_mean_b_h_code':str(ccap),'cap2_mean_b_e_code':str(ecap),
        'cap2_direct_complete_quantum_gain':full_info,
        'cap2_chain_rule_gain':float(1+mu)*4*hq,
        'cap2_abort_probability':str(mu*mu)}


if __name__ == '__main__':
    assert __debug__, 'run with assertions enabled'
    owner = load_owned_definitions()
    print(json.dumps({'provenance':owner.MONITOR_PROVENANCE,
        'native_literal100':native_inventory_report(owner),
        'new_all128_instrument':run_rational_fixture(),
        'new_price_algebra':run_price_algebra(),
        'new_complete_CQ':run_complete_quantum_info(),
        'old_suites_or_full_native_heat_replayed':False},indent=2))
