```python
    R_support=sparse.vstack([exact_support(block) for block in R_blocks],format='csr')
    closing_support=R_support@exact_support(actions[-1])

    # can remove an edge but can never add one. All coefficients here are

         which+' exact conservative graph has zero complete final clock diagonal block','exact_integer')

    dT=sparse.lil_matrix((D,D),dtype=float)
    dT[starts[old_index+1]:starts[old_index+1]+dims[old_index+1],
       starts[old_index]:starts[old_index]+dims[old_index]]=numeric(dgate)
    dT=dT.tocsr()
    dpattern=sparse.lil_matrix((D,D),dtype=np.int64)
    dpattern[starts[old_index+1]:starts[old_index+1]+dims[old_index+1],
             starts[old_index]:starts[old_index]+dims[old_index]]=exact_support(dgate)

    power=sparse.eye(D,format='csr'); support_power=sparse.eye(D,dtype=np.int64,format='csr')
    traces=[]; derivatives=[]
    for age in range(1,5):
        structural=(support_power@dpattern).diagonal()
        need(np.all(structural==0),which+f' age{age} cannot return through the actual old retention variation','exact_integer')
        derivatives.append(float(age*(power@dT).diagonal().sum()))
        power=power@T; support_power=support_power@pattern
        traces.append(float(power.diagonal().sum()))
    close(derivatives,np.zeros(4),which+' all checked low-winding old-source traces vanish')
    return dict(N=N,D=D,widths=dims,instruction_count=len(events)-5,
                birth_count=5,low_winding_traces=traces,old_source_traces=derivatives,
                sparse_entries=int(T.nnz),exact_support_entries=int(pattern.nnz),
                support_origin='exact Golden stage and closure supports; conservative integer products',
                profile='q=0 diagnostic; not the q>=3 asymptotic theorem')

clocks={name:build_clock(name) for name in ('noncommuting','canonical')}
close(clocks['noncommuting']['low_winding_traces'],clocks['canonical']['low_winding_traces'],
      'actual different retained prefixes have identical checked short-winding clock traces')

# A genuinely movable rank-one SCENE feedback projector needs no fixed orientation.
zeta,f0,f1=sp.symbols('zeta f0 f1',real=True)

# Generic noncommuting 2x2 return and its true negative logdet derivative.
```

Consequently PRD20 is a decisive incompatibility IF preserving this
proper-cut expectation is required of a proposed quotient. It is not a
proof that a diagonal-only future profile already admits the necessary
cut test after sealing. Any physically executed inverse/reader needs
its own allowed calls and clock. The original coherent master and its
proper cut have not been changed.

### 7fl.H. Actual independent current controls and the absolute Book price test

The source comparison PRD17 uses the stated full-operation task reactions.
It does not set a free current apparatus derivative to zero. The actual
paid-reader branches satisfy <zeta0,zeta1>=ap. A real unit-speed rotor
on the final pointer therefore gives

    partial_theta q|0=2ap,
    partial_theta f(q)|0=2ap f'(q)>0.                    (PRD21)

This is a smooth finite-matrix companion with the existing local native
finite-comparison compiler, not a continuously adjustable primitive.
At the XF target a rotor on f immediately BEFORE the CX instead has
partial_theta q=2ap p^3. For a general actual compiled prefix this row
is 2p^3 Re<u0_actual,u1_actual>; its genuine target error remains. If b is an independently variable normalized
current preparation at fixed E WITH its generated reference P_b=|b><b|
updated along it, its sphere-dual row is

    ||D_b f(q)||=2p^6 f'(q) sqrt(Q(1-Q))                 (PRD22)

for 0<Q<1. These are real nonzero rows, even at a field source zero.
They are distinct from the exactly neutral protected old-input rows.
A separately fixed or independently varied reference uses its full
actual response derivative, not PRD22 by assumption.

If a task truly admits the final pointer rotor, its accessible Bloch
interval contains p^2: the off-diagonal component is 2ap and
(2ap)^2>p^6=(1-2p^2)^2. The binary code component f(q) has its unique
minimum f(p^2)=0. At a crossing its rotor Hessian is
(q'(theta_*))^2/(ell p^3)>0. Thus solving THAT free row with no other
price reaction screens the binary field component. This does not
assert that the complete master or whole Cost-Info price has that
reduction: their genuine work/reactions remain. Under the stated
complete recorded task the rotor changes the required response and
needs the actual constraint reaction. It cannot be silently called
both a free control and a faithful vertical.

The complete branch valuation is also a testable operand. A single CX
does not emit the original variable-length direct0/return10 code. The
conditional charges 1+j in PRD9 must come from an actual encoder or a
proved existing code transport, including its STOP/continuation rule.
Fixed gate counts do not identify canonical description costs or the
whole work ledger.

For clarity apply BOOK_SOURCE_BINDING's already owned absolute-amplitude
theorem to the TWO normalized conditional pointer vectors at this same
complete prefix. Their branch isometries are I_old tensor nu_j, so an
arbitrary mixed Omega_< remains allowed without a newly supplied
purification. If the supplied terminal charges are c_j=1+j, the
Book amplitudes phi^(-c_j+I_j) reproduce their full normalized coherent
state only if, for a common real normalization J_r,

    I_j=c_j+ln(q_j)/(2ell)+J_r,
    I_1-I_0=1+ln(q/(1-q))/(2ell).                        (PRD23)

The common prefix amplitude and its physical cost remain outside this
conditional identity. On Q<1/2 the last gap is strictly greater than
one. Pointwise surprisal has the opposite-sign gap; equal information
assigned to both outcomes has gap zero. Neither is the required
amplitude binding.

If one ADDITIONALLY assumes the current conditional mean information
sum_j q_j I_j=h2(q)/ell, then the existing uniqueness theorem gives

    J_r=3h2(q)/(2ell)-(1+q),
    -ln||Q_Book,r||^2/(2ell)=1+q-3h2(q)/(2ell),
    d[-ln||Q_Book,r||^2/(2ell)]
             =d f(q)-d h2(q)/(2ell),
    d h2(q)/(2ell)=p^6 ln(q/(1-q)) DQ/(2ell).           (PRD24)

No extra choice remains in this conditional calculation, but the
additional assumption has NOT been derived from the original vertex
law. Its nonconstant normalization/source debt cannot be set to zero
by matching the Born probabilities. A scalar-probability binding or an
extra marker on an already executed Kraus amplitude has the different
coefficients of the owned theorem. They are not the same typed price.

### 7fl.I. Exact parent substitution and what remains to close

The new paid operation removes XF3's missing terminal readout map on

The complete JOINT terminal CQ calculation now has an actual operand,

No claim that all earlier marks fail the pointer quotient is made, and

#### 7fl.J1. Standalone `source_check.py`

```python
"""Exact Golden-field target algebra for the literal final CX reader.

The final reader is one actual native CX. F is the owned smooth XF target;
the check does not assert that every F has an exact finite positive word.
All predicates remain active with python -O.
"""
import json
import sympy as s

a = s.Symbol('a', real=True)
p = a*a
minimal = s.Poly(a**4+a*a-1, a, domain=s.QQ)
checks = []

def red(x):
    return s.rem(s.Poly(s.expand(x), a, domain=s.QQ), minimal).as_expr()

def matred(m):
    return m.applyfunc(red)

def zero(x, label):
    good = all(red(t) == 0 for t in x) if isinstance(x, s.MatrixBase) else red(x) == 0
    if not good:
        raise RuntimeError(label)
    checks.append(label)

I = s.eye(2)
X = s.Matrix([[0, 1], [1, 0]])
P0 = s.diag(1, 0)
P1 = s.diag(0, 1)
G = s.Matrix([[a, -p], [p, a]])
v = s.Matrix([a, p])
Pb = matred(v*v.T)
E = P1
ce = s.kronecker_product(E, I)+s.kronecker_product(I-E, X)
cp = s.kronecker_product(Pb, I)+s.kronecker_product(I-Pb, X)
F = matred(ce*cp)
CX = s.kronecker_product(P0, I)+s.kronecker_product(P1, X)
reader = s.kronecker_product(I, CX)
U = matred(reader*s.kronecker_product(F, I))
V = s.kronecker_product(U, I)  # last spectator t, retained in full
born = s.kronecker_product(v, v, v, v)
out = matred(V*born)
Q = red((v.T*E*v)[0])
q = red(p*p+p**4-p**6*Q)
flag_event = s.kronecker_product(I, P1, I, I)
pointer_event = s.kronecker_product(I, I, P1, I)

zero(G.T*G-I, 'Golden G is orthogonal on the actual field')
zero((v.T*v)[0]-1, 'canonical birth is normalized')
zero((v.T*G*v)[0]-a, 'actual Golden cold amplitude is a')
zero(CX.T*CX-s.eye(4), 'literal final CX is all-column orthogonal')
zero(F.T*F-s.eye(4), 'full XF target is orthogonal')
zero(U.T*U-s.eye(8), 'complete read target is all-column orthogonal')
zero(V.T*V-s.eye(16), 'last spectator and every target column retained')
zero(red(F.det())-1, 'fixture XF determinant is plus one')
zero(CX.det()+1, 'local two-bit CX determinant is minus one')
zero(CX.det()**4-1, 'even bank and spectator multiplicity give SO target')
zero((out.T*out)[0]-1, 'complete initialized output is normalized')

partial_trace_reader = s.Matrix([[sum(CX[2*i+r, 2*j+r] for r in range(2))
                                  for j in range(2)] for i in range(2)])
zero(partial_trace_reader-2*P0, 'reader partial trace is exactly two P0')
zero(s.trace(U)-s.trace(F), 'complete newest-detail trace unchanged by paid CX read')
zero(s.trace(V)-2*s.trace(F), 'full spectator trace multiplicity retained')
zero((out.T*flag_event*out)[0]-(p-p**3*Q), 'flag probability is unchanged by pointer read')
zero((out.T*pointer_event*out)[0]-q, 'actual pointer law p2 plus p4 minus p6 Q')
zero(q-((1+p**6)/2-p**6*Q), 'pointer law has symmetric interval about one half')
zero(q-(p*p+p**3*(p-p**3*Q)), 'literal noisy-channel composition has gain p3')

cold = red((born.T*out)[0])
cold_formula = a*p+2*p**3+p**4*(1-a)*Q
zero(cold-cold_formula, 'original born cold corner after the literal reader')
zero(cold_formula-(a*p+2*p**3+(p+2*a*p**3-a*p-2*p**3)*Q),
     'both stated cold formulas agree')

# Original projection varies by a genuine real orthogonal conjugation.
generator = s.Matrix([[0, -1], [1, 0]])
dE = generator*E-E*generator
dQ = red((v.T*dE*v)[0])
dce = s.kronecker_product(dE, I-X)
dF = matred(dce*cp)
dU = matred(reader*s.kronecker_product(dF, I))
dV = s.kronecker_product(dU, I)
dout = matred(dV*born)
zero(s.trace(dF)-4*dQ, 'XF full trace source is four DQ')
zero(s.trace(dU)-4*dQ, 'paid reader retains the full trace source')
zero(2*(out.T*pointer_event*dout)[0]+p**6*dQ,
     'full pointer derivative is minus p6 DQ')
zero((born.T*dout)[0]-p**4*(1-a)*dQ,
     'full cold derivative retains its true coefficient')
if dQ == 0:
    raise RuntimeError('nonzero source fixture')
checks.append('nonzero original-projection tangent in the same fixture')

# Hostile controls: no perfect copy is alleged; omitted read and unretained
# full state cannot be silently identified with the new pointer.
if red(q-(p-p**3*Q)) == 0:
    raise RuntimeError('noisy pointer differs from original flag')
checks.append('negative control: pointer is noisy and differs from original flag')
for bit, proj in enumerate((s.eye(16)-pointer_event, pointer_event)):
    branch = matred(proj*out)
    weight = red((branch.T*branch)[0])
    zero(weight-(1-q if bit == 0 else q), f'full branch {bit} has correct weight')
    rho = matred(branch*branch.T)
    zero(rho*rho-weight*rho, f'full retained branch {bit} is rank-one before normalization')

rho_coherent = matred(out*out.T)
rho_pinched = matred(pointer_event*rho_coherent*pointer_event
                    +(s.eye(16)-pointer_event)*rho_coherent*(s.eye(16)-pointer_event))
prelast = matred(s.kronecker_product(F, I, I)*born)
g_last = s.kronecker_product(reader, I)
zero(g_last*(prelast*prelast.T)*g_last.T-rho_coherent,
     'output predicate is the original generated cut transported by the real last CX')
zero(s.trace(rho_coherent*rho_coherent)-1,
     'coherent output has unit expectation in its generated predicate')
zero(s.trace(rho_coherent*rho_pinched)-(q*q+(1-q)**2),
     'pinched output has the exact nonunit proper-cut expectation')
if red(1-s.trace(rho_coherent*rho_pinched)) == 0:
    raise RuntimeError('proper-cut distinction was erased')
checks.append('negative control: full generated predicate distinguishes coherent and CQ states')

payload = {
    'scope': 'Exact Golden target/readout algebra; last reader is a literal CX; compilation and complete-price selection are separate.',
    'field': 'QQ[a]/(a^4+a^2-1), positive real root a=sqrt(phi^-1)',
    'checks': checks,
    'check_count': len(checks),
    'fixture_Q': str(Q),
    'fixture_DQ': str(dQ),
    'fixture_pointer_probability': str(q),
    'fixture_cold': str(cold),
    'full_target_dimension': 16,
    'literal_final_reader_calls': 1,
    'full_Cost_Info_selected': False,
    'GR_closed': False,
}
print(json.dumps(payload, ensure_ascii=False, sort_keys=True, indent=2))
```

#### 7fl.J2. Standalone `check_reader_algebra.py`

```python
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Exact XF reader application; no entropy/physical-price selection asserted."""
from __future__ import annotations
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path
import sympy as s

a,t=s.symbols('a t',real=True)
p=a*a
poly=a**4+a*a-1
v=s.Matrix([a,p]); G=s.Matrix([[a,-p],[p,a]])
X=s.Matrix([[0,1],[1,0]]); Z=s.diag(1,-1)
checks=[]
def need(ok,label):
    if not bool(ok): raise ArithmeticError(label)
    checks.append(label)
def red(e):
    num,den=s.fraction(s.cancel(e))
    return s.cancel(s.rem(num,poly,a)/s.rem(den,poly,a)) if not den.has(a) else s.rem(s.rem(num,poly,a)*s.invert(s.rem(den,poly,a),poly,a),poly,a)
def mat(M): return M.applyfunc(red)
def eq(A,B): return A.shape==B.shape and all(red(e)==0 for e in A-B)
def kron(*M): return s.kronecker_product(*M)
def power(n):
    out=s.eye(2)
    for _ in range(n): out=mat(G*out)
    return out
I2=s.eye(2); I4=s.eye(4)
q0=s.diag(1,0);q1=I2-q0
CX=kron(q0,I2)+kron(q1,X)
Evec=s.Matrix([(1-t*t)/(1+t*t),2*t/(1+t*t)])
E=Evec*Evec.T; P=v*v.T
need(eq(E*E,E),'generic rational real field projector is idempotent')
need(not eq(E*P,P*E),'field projector and actual born input projector are not generically commuting')
def controlled(A): return kron(A,I2)+kron(I2-A,X)
F=mat(controlled(E)*controlled(P)); Q=red((v.T*E*v)[0])
need(eq(F.T*F,I4),'full XF comparison is exactly orthogonal for generic field')
need(eq(F*kron(v,v),kron(E*v,v)+kron((I2-E)*v,X*v)),
     'actual initialized XF output retains both nonorthogonal flag sectors')
R0=kron(I2,CX)
need(eq(R0.T*R0,s.eye(8)),'literal single-CX reader is orthogonal on all8 columns')
need(eq(R0*R0,s.eye(8)),'actual CX reader inverse is the same paid primitive')
need(red(s.trace(R0*kron(F,I2))-s.trace(F))==0,
     'actual one-CX reader full trace equals original XF full trace')
need(red(s.diff(s.trace(R0*kron(F,I2)),t)-4*s.diff(Q,t))==0,
     'all-column trace field derivative remains exactly4 DQ')
state=mat(R0*kron(F,I2)*kron(v,v,v))
blocks=[s.Matrix([state[2*j+i] for j in range(4)]) for i in range(2)]
probs=[red((w.T*w)[0]) for w in blocks]
bflag0=red(p*p+p**3*Q)
q1=red(p*p+p**4-p**6*Q)
need(red(sum(probs)-1)==0,'both actual pointer outcomes exhaust the initialized state')
need(red(probs[1]-q1)==0,'actual pointer-one law is p2+p4-p6 Q')
need(red(probs[1]-(p*p*bflag0+p*(1-bflag0)))==0,
     'actual pointer law keeps canonical-born noise conditioned on the real flag')
need(red(s.diff(probs[1],t)+p**6*s.diff(Q,t))==0,
     'actual pointer field source is exactly minus p6 DQ')
need(red((v.T*X*v)[0]-2*a*p)==0,
     'conditional fresh-pointer vectors remain nonorthogonal; no perfect copy is claimed')
cold=red((kron(v,v,v).T*state)[0]); overlap=2*a*p
need(red(cold-Q*(p+p*p*overlap)-(1-Q)*a*p*(1+overlap))==0,
     'full prepared return includes actual born pointer and every bank/flag amplitude')
need(red(s.diff(cold,t)-(p+p*p*overlap-a*p*(1+overlap))*s.diff(Q,t))==0,
     'complete prepared cold first-source keeps the real reader coefficient')
oldX=kron(I2,X,I2)
transported=mat(R0*oldX*R0.T)
need(eq(transported,kron(I2,X,X)),
     'pointer initially spectator acquires joint X reader for inherited flag-X mark')
need(not eq(transported*kron(I4,Z),kron(I4,Z)*transported),
     'pointer freshness alone does not make inherited transported marks diagonal')
oldE=kron(E,I2,I2)
need(eq(R0*oldE*R0.T,oldE),'original commuting fine report effects stay pointer diagonal')
need(eq(kron(R0,I2).T*kron(R0,I2),s.eye(16)),
     'actual last-spectator embedding is orthogonal on all16 columns')
need(red(s.trace(kron(R0*kron(F,I2),I2))-2*s.trace(F))==0,
     'actual last spectator doubles trace without selecting a flag sector')
# Refine by the original bank report E.  Every branch retains B, f, r.
branch_probs=[]
for bank_effect in (E,I2-E):
    branch=mat(kron(bank_effect,I2,I2)*state)
    branch_probs.append([red(sum(branch[2*j+i]**2 for j in range(4))) for i in range(2)])
k=red(p*p+p**4-p**6)
need(red(branch_probs[0][1]-Q*k)==0 and red(branch_probs[1][1]-(1-Q)*(1-k))==0,
     'original report-conditioned pointer-one probabilities are complementary fixed laws')
need(red(k-2*p**3)==0,
     'conditional pointer-one parameter for original E report is exactly2 p3')
need(red(probs[1]-(Q*k+(1-Q)*(1-k)))==0,
     'all original report and pointer branches are kept in the joint law')
lo,hi=[ab for ab,m in s.Poly(poly,a).intervals(eps=s.Rational(1,10**40)) if ab[0]>0 and m==1][0]
need(lo>0 and hi<1,'positive Golden root gives a strictly nonzero pointer gain p6')
need(red((p*p+p**4-p**6/s.Integer(2))-s.Rational(1,2))==0,
     'on Q from0 to1/2 the actual pointer probability runs from p2+p4 to1/2')
print(json.dumps(dict(status='PASS',check_count=len(checks),checks=checks,
    checker_sha256=hashlib.sha256(Path(__file__).read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
    literal_reader=dict(g_calls=0,cx_calls=1,births=1,chronology='CX(f,r)',free_inverse=False),
    exact=dict(pointer_one='p^2+p^4-p^6 Q',pointer_gain='-p^6',
               conditional_pointer_one='2p^3 on E; 1-2p^3 on complement',
               prepared_cold='Q(p+p^2 s)+(1-Q)ap(1+s), s=2ap',trace_gain='1'),
    scope=dict(generic_real_field=True,all_columns=True,complete_Cost_Info_selected=False,
               pointer_algebra_exhaustion_proved=False,GR_closed=False)),sort_keys=True,indent=2))
```

```python
"""Small exact check of the new code/pointer full-source target identities.

The actual clock tails and native resource order are analytic in source.md.
No exact finite native stationary-root or complete Cost-Info claim is made.
"""
import json
import sympy as s

a, ca, sa, ct, st, M = s.symbols('a ca sa ct st M', real=True)
p = a*a
domain = s.QQ.frac_field(ca, sa, ct, st, M)
minimal = s.Poly(a**4+a*a-1, a, domain=domain)
checks = []

def red(x):
    return s.rem(s.Poly(s.expand(x), a, domain=domain), minimal).as_expr()

def mr(x):
    return x.applyfunc(red)

def zero(x, name):
    ok = all(red(y) == 0 for y in x) if isinstance(x, s.MatrixBase) else red(x) == 0
    if not ok:
        raise RuntimeError(name)
    checks.append(name)

I=s.eye(2); X=s.Matrix([[0,1],[1,0]]); J=s.Matrix([[0,-1],[1,0]])
P0=s.diag(1,0); P1=s.diag(0,1)
v=s.Matrix([a,p]); G=s.Matrix([[a,-p],[p,a]])
rotA=ca*I+sa*J; rotT=ct*I+st*J
CX=s.kronecker_product(P0,I)+s.kronecker_product(P1,X)
enc=s.kronecker_product(P0,rotA)+s.kronecker_product(P1,G.T)
v_tail=s.kronecker_product(I,v)
zero(v_tail.T*enc*v_tail-(ca*P0+a*P1), 'general code born-tail compression')
partial=s.Matrix([[sum(enc[2*i+t,2*j+t] for t in range(2)) for j in range(2)] for i in range(2)])
zero(partial-2*(ca*P0+a*P1), 'general code full-tail trace')
zero(enc.T*enc-s.eye(4)-(ca**2+sa**2-1)*s.kronecker_product(P0,I), 'encoder orthogonality uses only alpha circle')
zero(G.T*v-s.Matrix([1,0]), 'entangled branch-one tail is exactly zero')
zero(CX*s.kronecker_product(I,G)*CX-enc.subs({ca:a,sa:p}), 'three-call code anchor is exact')

# This fixture consumes the original comparison operator and a genuine
# projection tangent. It retains every bank, flag, pointer and tail column.
Pb=mr(v*v.T); E=P1
cp=s.kronecker_product(Pb,I)+s.kronecker_product(I-Pb,X)
ce=s.kronecker_product(E,I)+s.kronecker_product(I-E,X)
F=mr(ce*cp); Q=red((v.T*E*v)[0]); T=s.trace(F)
reader=s.kronecker_product(I,CX)
U=mr(reader*s.kronecker_product(F,I))
before=mr(s.kronecker_product(I,I,rotT)*U)
coded=mr(s.kronecker_product(I,I,enc)*s.kronecker_product(before,I))
mult=(ca+a)*ct+(a-ca)*st
zero(s.trace(coded)-mult*T, 'entire code-pointer endpoint trace has exact M multiplier')
zero(T-(2-2+4*Q), 'full original comparison trace at the nontrivial fixture')
dE=J*E-E*J; dQ=red((v.T*dE*v)[0])
dF=mr(s.kronecker_product(dE,I-X)*cp)
dU=mr(reader*s.kronecker_product(dF,I))
dcode=mr(s.kronecker_product(I,I,enc)*s.kronecker_product(s.kronecker_product(I,I,rotT)*dU,I))
zero(s.trace(dcode)-4*mult*dQ, 'full field source has multiplier 4 M DQ')
if dQ == 0:
    raise RuntimeError('nonzero actual projection tangent')
checks.append('nonzero actual projection tangent')

born=s.kronecker_product(v,v,v,v)
cold=red((born.T*coded*born)[0])
A0=p**2*(1+a)+p**3*(a-p)*Q; A1=p**2*(1+a)
formula=a*((ca*ct+p*st)*A0+(p*ct-ca*st)*A1)
zero(cold-formula, 'complete cold formula retains code-tail and pointer controls')
c0=a*p+2*p**3+p**4*(1-a)*Q
d0=-p**4*(a+(p-a)*Q)
zero(cold.subs(ca,a)-a*(c0*ct+d0*st), 'three-call anchor multiplies true rotated cold by a')
zero(s.diff(cold,sa), 'born cold has no sine-alpha term')

pointer=s.kronecker_product(I,I,P1)
out=mr(U*s.kronecker_product(v,v,v))
q0=(1+p**6)/2-p**6*Q
zero((out.T*pointer*out)[0]-q0, 'original paid reader probability')
dout=mr(s.kronecker_product(I,I,J)*out)
zero(2*(out.T*pointer*dout)[0]-2*a*p, 'free pointer has nonzero actual CQ row')
rotout=mr(s.kronecker_product(I,I,rotT)*out)
zero((rotout.T*pointer*rotout)[0]-(ct**2*q0+st**2*(1-q0)+2*a*p*ct*st), 'complete rotated pointer probability')

# The stationary section uses M^2=2(1+p). Multiplying by M avoids any
# chosen algebraic square-root branch in this exact polynomial receipt.
cs=(1+a)/M; ss=(a-1)/M
zero(M**2*(cs**2+ss**2)-2*(1+p), 'positive M section is normalized by M squared')
zero(M*((1+a)*cs+(a-1)*ss)-2*(1+p), 'positive multiplier at stationary section')
zero(-(1+a)*ss+(a-1)*cs, 'pointer leading row vanishes at the section')
zero(M*(-cs+ss)+2, 'alpha Hessian is minus two over M')
zero(M*(-(1+a)*cs-(a-1)*ss)+2*(1+p), 'theta Hessian is minus M')
# M_alpha is -sin(alpha)*(cos(theta)-sin(theta)); therefore both its
# value and mixed alpha/theta derivative vanish at alpha=0 identically.
alpha,theta=s.symbols('alpha theta', real=True)
mf=(s.cos(alpha)+a)*s.cos(theta)+(a-s.cos(alpha))*s.sin(theta)
zero(s.diff(mf,alpha).subs(alpha,0), 'alpha leading row vanishes without field tuning')
zero(s.diff(mf,alpha,theta).subs(alpha,0), 'mixed nuisance Hessian is zero')
zero(M**2*(2*cs*ss)+2*(1+p)*p**3, 'sin two theta at section equals minus p cubed')
zero(M**2*(cs**2-ss**2)-2*(1+p)*(2*a*p), 'cos two theta at section equals two ap')
zero(p**6*p**3*(1-2*Q)+4*a*a*p*p-(p**9*(1-2*Q)+4*p**3), 'CQ pointer derivative at section retains its independent row')

print(json.dumps({
    'scope':'exact target composition and new two-control first/second jets; full growing-clock remainder is analytic',
    'checks':checks, 'check_count':len(checks),
    'fixture_Q':str(Q), 'fixture_DQ':str(dQ),
    'code_pointer_target_dimension_without_last_spectator':16,
    'GR_closed':False, 'exact_finite_stationary_native_word_claimed':False,
},ensure_ascii=False,sort_keys=True,indent=2))
```

```python
"""Exact new local-control identities; no root search or whole-price replacement."""
import json
import sympy as s

a, u, h, mu, ca, sa, cb, sb, ct, st = s.symbols('a u h mu ca sa cb sb ct st', real=True)
p=a*a
parameters=(u,h,mu,ca,sa,cb,sb,ct,st)
domain=s.QQ.frac_field(*parameters)
poly=s.Poly(a**4+a*a-1,a,domain=domain)
checks=[]

def red(x):
    return s.rem(s.Poly(s.expand(x),a,domain=domain),poly).as_expr()

def mr(x): return x.applyfunc(red)

def zero(x,label):
    ok=all(red(v)==0 for v in x) if isinstance(x,s.MatrixBase) else red(x)==0
    if not ok: raise RuntimeError(label)
    checks.append(label)

def constrained(x):
    x=s.rem(s.Poly(s.expand(x),h,domain=s.QQ.frac_field(a,u)),s.Poly(h*h+u*u-1,h,domain=s.QQ.frac_field(a,u))).as_expr()
    return red(x)

I=s.eye(2); J=s.Matrix([[0,-1],[1,0]])
P0=s.diag(1,0); P1=s.diag(0,1); X=s.Matrix([[0,1],[1,0]])
v=s.Matrix([a,p]); w=s.Matrix([-p,a]); G=s.Matrix([[a,-p],[p,a]])
j=s.kronecker_product(I,v); jp=s.kronecker_product(I,w)
Pj=mr(j*j.T); P=s.kronecker_product((I+X)/2,I)
E=s.kronecker_product(P0,ca*I+sa*J)+s.kronecker_product(P1,G.T)
Kb=mr(Pj+jp*(cb*I+sb*J)*jp.T)
zero(Kb*j-j, 'all initialized pointer inputs are fixed by the dark completion')
zero(jp.T*jp-I,'the unused input columns have their true orthonormal basis')
EU=mr(E*Kb)
ptr=s.Matrix([[sum(EU[2*r+t,2*k+t] for t in range(2)) for k in range(2)] for r in range(2)])
zero(ptr-s.diag(ca,a)*(I+cb*I+sb*J),'full dark partial trace is D times I plus Rbeta')
Ot=ct*I+st*J
mt=(ca+a)*ct+(a-ca)*st
ctb=ct*cb-st*sb; stb=st*cb+ct*sb
mtb=(ca+a)*ctb+(a-ca)*stb
zero(s.trace(mr(EU*s.kronecker_product(Ot,I))*P)-(mt+mtb)/2,'full three-angle trace multiplier is the average of the two sharp multipliers')

# New validity-only direction at the old stationary section.
Ostar=s.Matrix([[1+a,1-a],[a-1,1+a]])/mu
Esharp=s.kronecker_product(P0,I)+s.kronecker_product(P1,G.T)
Ustar=mr(Esharp*s.kronecker_product(Ostar,I))
w0=s.kronecker_product(s.Matrix([1,0]),w)
e10=s.Matrix([0,0,1,0]); e11=s.Matrix([0,0,0,1])
Kchi=mr(e10*w0.T-w0*e10.T)
Pplane=mr(w0*w0.T+e10*e10.T)
zero(Kchi.T+Kchi,'chi generator is a real skew tangent')
zero(Kchi*e11,'chi generator fixes the invalid output column')
zero(e11.T*Ustar*j,'the old section is code valid on every initialized input')
zero(mu*s.trace(Ustar*P)-2*(1+p),'old full-trace coefficient is mu0')
zero(mu*s.trace(Kchi*Ustar*P)+p,'new chi full-trace first row is minus p over mu0')
zero(mu*s.trace(Pplane*Ustar*P)-(1+p),'chi cosine coefficient is mu0 over two')
zero(s.kronecker_product(v,v).T*Kchi*Ustar*j,'new cold first row vanishes on every initialized pointer input')
Pe=e10*e10.T
zero(j.T*Ustar.T*(Kchi.T*Pe+Pe*Kchi)*Ustar*j,'new decoded-return effect first row vanishes')
if all(red(x)==0 for x in Kchi*Ustar*j):
    raise RuntimeError('chi must change the complete prepared state')
checks.append('hostile control: chi changes the prepared quantum state despite zero probability and cold first rows')
zero((1+p)**2+p*p-3,'strict improvement amplitude reduces to sqrt(3p/2)')
zero(p-(1+p)*p*p,'the strict improvement angle has tangent minus p squared, with positive denominator cleared')

# Independent fixed-k Procrustes invariants in (+v,+w,-v,-w).
Pdiag=s.diag(1,1,0,0)
z=s.Matrix([p,a,-p,-a])/s.sqrt(2)
k=s.Matrix([0,u,0,h])
A=(s.eye(4)-z*z.T)*Pdiag*(s.eye(4)-k*k.T)
Gram=A.T*A
frob=constrained(s.trace(Gram))
prod=constrained((s.trace(Gram)**2-s.trace(Gram*Gram))/2)
zero(frob-(s.Rational(3,2)-(1-p/2)*u*u),'rank-two Procrustes squared norm is the displayed polynomial')
zero(prod-(1-u*u)/2,'rank-two Procrustes squared singular product is one half times one minus u squared')
zero(s.sqrt(2)*(z.T*Pdiag*k)[0]-a*u,'fixed scalar trace term is a u over sqrt two')
zero((z.T*z)[0]-1,'the physical invalid vector is normalized in the adapted basis')
zero((z.T*Pdiag*z)[0]-s.Rational(1,2),'physical invalid vector has exactly one half in the trace subspace')

print(json.dumps({
    'scope':'exact local valid-code trace, sharp-fibre completion, new chi counterrow, and full Procrustes invariants',
    'check_count':len(checks),'checks':checks,
    'maximizer_computed_numerically':False,
    'GR_closed':False,'exact_finite_stationary_native_word_claimed':False,
```

```python
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Exact four-column screened-code target and original one-CX all-input map.

The screened SO(4) matrix is a mathematical target, not an emitted native word.
Only the reader CX is evaluated through the pinned original native owner.
No heat diagonalization, root search, or physical Info selection is performed.
"""
from __future__ import annotations
import argparse
import hashlib
import importlib.util

from pathlib import Path
import platform

import sympy as sp

parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
parser.add_argument('--repo', type=Path, required=True)
args = parser.parse_args()
owner_rel = '02_REGISTRY/research/sources/d0_native_execution_domain_2026-10-24/native_execution.py'
owner_sha = '222eafaffa4b30f175919a32c940534b82f3a2b9af89c7897d318dd004a2007c'

def need(ok, label, kind='exact_symbolic'):
    if not bool(ok):
        raise ArithmeticError(label)
    checks.append({'label': label, 'kind': kind})

owner = args.repo / owner_rel
need(hashlib.sha256(owner.read_bytes()).hexdigest() == owner_sha,
     'pinned original native execution owner', 'provenance')
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('screened_code_native_owner', owner)
if spec is None or spec.loader is None:
    raise RuntimeError('native owner loader unavailable')
ne = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
sys.modules[spec.name] = ne
spec.loader.exec_module(ne)

# p,a retain their original Golden polynomial and positive branches. s,c are
# positive square roots with s^2=lambda0 and c^2=1-lambda0, reduced exactly.
a, p, s, c = sp.symbols('a p s c', positive=True)
rt2 = sp.sqrt(2)
base = sp.groebner([a*a-p, p*p+p-1], a, p, extension=rt2)
lam = 2*p*p/(1+2*a*p)

def normal(expr):
    expr = sp.expand(expr)
    expr = sp.rem(sp.Poly(expr, c, domain='EX'),
                  sp.Poly(c*c+s*s-1, c, domain='EX')).as_expr()
    expr = sp.rem(sp.Poly(expr, s, domain='EX'),
                  sp.Poly(s*s-lam, s, domain='EX')).as_expr()
    numerator, denominator = sp.together(expr).as_numer_denom()
    # Denominators are powers of 1+2ap and rational constants, all nonzero
    # on the explicitly pinned positive Golden branch.
    terms = sp.Poly(sp.expand(numerator), s, c, domain="EX").terms()
    reduced = sum(base.reduce(sp.expand(coef))[1] * s**mon[0] * c**mon[1]
                  for mon, coef in terms)
    return sp.expand(reduced) / denominator

def eq(A, B):
    A, B = sp.Matrix(A), sp.Matrix(B)
    return A.shape == B.shape and all(normal(x) == 0 for x in A-B)

def kron(*xs):
    return sp.kronecker_product(*xs)

I2 = sp.eye(2)
e0, e1 = sp.Matrix([1, 0]), sp.Matrix([0, 1])
v, w = sp.Matrix([a, p]), sp.Matrix([-p, a])
plus, minus = (e0+e1)/rt2, (e0-e1)/rt2
P0, P1, Pplus = e0*e0.T, e1*e1.T, plus*plus.T
need(ne.exact_matrix_equal(sp.Matrix(ne.G_LOCAL),
                          sp.Matrix([[ne.A, -ne.P], [ne.P, ne.A]])),
     'symbolic Golden convention agrees with pinned original G')
need(bool((ne.P-sp.Rational(1, 2)).is_positive) and bool((1-ne.P).is_positive)
     and bool(ne.A.is_positive), 'original positive branches have 1/2<p<1 and a>0')
need(normal((sp.Rational(1, 2)+a*p-p*p)-(a*p+p-sp.Rational(1, 2))) == 0,
     'lambda denominator exceeds p2 by the positive sum ap+p-1/2')
need(normal((a-p)*(a+p)-p**3) == 0,
     'a exceeds p because (a-p)(a+p)=p3 and a+p is positive')
need(eq(sp.Matrix.hstack(v, w).T*sp.Matrix.hstack(v, w), I2),
     'canonical born and unused orthogonal tail columns form the full frame')

x, y, z, t = kron(plus, v), kron(minus, v), kron(plus, w), kron(minus, w)
B = sp.Matrix.hstack(x, y, z, t)
b00, b01, b10, b11 = [sp.eye(4)[:, i] for i in range(4)]
C = sp.Matrix.hstack(c*b00+s*b10, b01, -s*b00+c*b10, -b11)
U = C*B.T
need(eq(B.T*B, sp.eye(4)) and normal(B.det()+1) == 0,
     'ordered complete input basis is orthogonal with orientation minus one')
need(eq(C.T*C, sp.eye(4)) and normal(C.det()+1) == 0,
     'ordered complete output basis is orthogonal with orientation minus one')
need(eq(U.T*U, sp.eye(4)) and normal(U.det()-1) == 0,
     'full four-column screened target is special orthogonal')
need(eq(U*x, c*b00+s*b10) and eq(U*y, b01)
     and eq(U*z, -s*b00+c*b10) and eq(U*t, -b11),
     'all four specified target columns, including the dirty complement, are retained')

J = kron(I2, v)
W = U*J
F0, F1, Fail = kron(P0, I2), kron(P1, P0), kron(P1, P1)
need(eq(F0+F1+Fail, sp.eye(4)) and eq(F0*F1, sp.zeros(4))
     and eq(F0*Fail, sp.zeros(4)) and eq(F1*Fail, sp.zeros(4)),
     'direct return and invalid effects exhaust all four output columns')
need(eq(W.T*W, I2), 'complete initialized screened code is an isometry')
need(eq(Fail*W, sp.zeros(4, 2)), 'every incoming pointer state produces valid code without postselection')
need(not eq(Fail*U, sp.zeros(4)), 'invalid dirty full columns are not removed from the target')
A1, A0 = W.T*F1*W, W.T*F0*W
need(eq(A1, lam*Pplus), 'full return effect is lambda0 times Pplus on every input')
need(eq(A0, I2-lam*Pplus), 'full direct effect is the complete complement of the return effect')
L = F0+2*F1
need(eq(W.T*L*W, I2+lam*Pplus), 'original valid code-length effect is I plus return effect')
M = sp.trace(U*kron(Pplus, I2))
M_claim = ((a-p)*c+(a+p)*s)/rt2
need(normal(M-M_claim) == 0,
     'full trace coefficient is ((a-p)c+(a+p)s)/sqrt2 with positive factors')

# Actual original literal reader, all f/r/t columns. Tail is untouched.
reader_word = (ne.Gate('CX', (0, 1)),)
reader_ex = ne.Execution(3, (), (), reader_word, profile=ne.G_CX, report_bits=(1, 2))
ne.validate_execution(reader_ex, max_qubits=3, max_expanded_stages=1)
reader = sp.Matrix(ne.word_matrix(reader_ex, max_qubits=3, max_expanded_stages=1))
need(ne.inventory(reader_ex, max_qubits=3, max_expanded_stages=1).cx_count == 1,
     'pinned native grammar executes exactly one CX reader and no new helper', 'native_syntax')
CXfr = kron(P0, I2)+kron(P1, sp.Matrix([[0, 1], [1, 0]]))
need(eq(reader, kron(CXfr, I2)), 'literal native reader acts as CX(f,r) and identity on the entire tail')
Jread = kron(I2, v, v)
V = kron(I2, U)*reader*Jread
Pdirect, Preturn, Pinvalid = kron(I2, F0), kron(I2, F1), kron(I2, Fail)
need(eq(V.T*V, I2), 'composed actual reader and target code retain a complete two-column input isometry')
need(eq(Pinvalid*V, sp.zeros(8, 2)), 'composed reader-code has no invalid branch for any f input')
K1, K0 = Preturn*V, Pdirect*V
need(eq(K1.T*K1, p*p*I2), 'composed full return effect is exactly p2 I on the entire f input')
need(eq(K0.T*K0, p*I2), 'composed full direct effect is exactly p I on the entire f input')
need(eq(K1.T*K1+K0.T*K0, I2), 'all initialized outcome mass is retained without normalization or selection')
need(eq(V.T*kron(I2, L)*V, (1+p*p)*I2),
     'actual original code cost is exactly (1+p2)I on every input')
# Tensor identities explicitly retain an arbitrary two-dimensional old/reference.
Vref = kron(I2, V)
need(eq(Vref.T*kron(I2, Preturn)*Vref, p*p*sp.eye(4))
     and eq(Vref.T*kron(I2, Pdirect)*Vref, p*sp.eye(4)),
     'scalar outcome effects preserve arbitrary old-reference coherences and entanglement')
need(eq((K0/sp.sqrt(p)).T*(K0/sp.sqrt(p)), I2)
     and eq((K1/p).T*(K1/p), I2),
     'both normalized complete conditional branches are isometries, including mixed inputs')
need(normal(p+2*p*p-(1+p*p)) == 0,
     'Golden outcome entropy in log-phi units equals the actual 1+p2 code charge')
q, ell = sp.symbols('q ell', positive=True)
f = 1+q+((1-q)*sp.log(1-q)+q*sp.log(q))/ell
Dover = ((1-q)*(sp.log(1-q)+ell)+q*(sp.log(q)+2*ell))/ell
need(sp.simplify(Dover-f) == 0,
     'specified binary code-minus-Shannon price is the relative entropy to (p,p2) divided by ell')

summary = {
```

```python
    for F in mats: out.append(F*out[-1])
    return out

A=ne.Gate('CX',(1,2)); B=ne.Gate('CX',(2,3)); C=ne.Gate('CX',(1,3))
words=[(A,)*10,(A,B,A,B,C)*2]
suffix=(ne.Gate('CX',(1,2)),ne.Gate('CX',(2,3)),ne.Gate('G',(3,)),ne.Gate('CX',(2,3)))
ms=[matrices(w) for w in words]; ps=[prefixes(m) for m in ms]
for i in range(2):
    inv=ne.inventory(execution(words[i]+suffix),max_qubits=4,max_expanded_stages=14)
    need((inv.gate_count,inv.g_count,inv.cx_count,inv.source_i_count)==(14,1,13,0),f'word {i} has actual fourteen calls one G thirteen CX','native_syntax')
    need(eq(ps[i][-1],s.eye(16)),f'word {i} is exact identity on all sixteen columns')
need(eq(ms[1][4]*ms[1][3]*ms[1][2]*ms[1][1]*ms[1][0],s.eye(16)),'literal chronological five-CX relation is identity')
need(words[0]!=words[1],'the actual retained instruction words are different','native_syntax')
V=[ps[1][j]*ps[0][j].T for j in range(11)]
need(eq(V[0],s.eye(16)) and eq(V[-1],s.eye(16)),'both complete segment marks have identity gauge')
for j in range(10):
    need(eq(ms[1][j],V[j+1]*ms[0][j]*V[j].T),f'all-column native prefix gauge on interval edge {j}')
need(any(not eq(v,s.eye(16)) for v in V),'intermediate gauges are nontrivial')
for j,vj in enumerate(V):
    need(eq(vj,s.kronecker_product(s.eye(2),vj[:8,:8])),f'prefix {j} preserves arbitrary protected old factor')

# Real canonical birth embeddings precede the interval. Their identity
# gauges verify the R landing condition without forming a dense 238 clock.
a=ne.A;p=ne.P; born=s.Matrix([a,p]); I2=s.eye(2)
births=[s.kronecker_product(s.eye(d),born) for d in (2,4,8)]
for j,J in enumerate(births):
    need(eq(J.T*J,s.eye(J.cols)),f'canonical birth {j} is an actual full isometry')
    need(eq(s.eye(J.rows)*J,J*s.eye(J.cols)),f'prefix gauge fixes canonical birth {j}')
    D=s.eye(J.rows)-J*J.T
    need(eq(D*J,s.zeros(J.rows,J.cols)),f'full birth detail {j} is retained and orthogonal')
need(sum((2,4,8)+(16,)*14)==238,'actual stage dimension includes all three births and fourteen gates')

full=[matrices(w+suffix) for w in words]
fullp=[prefixes(m) for m in full]
need(eq(fullp[0][-1],fullp[1][-1]),'same actual paid reader and code suffix have equal complete endpoints')
for j in range(10,15):
    need(eq(fullp[1][j]*fullp[0][j].T,s.eye(16)),f'every downstream prefix {j} is unchanged')
need((words[0]+suffix)[-1].op=='CX' and suffix[-2].op=='G','true final and preceding square gates are retained','native_syntax')

# A generic complete initial old cut is not collapsed to one prepared row.
Jall=births[2]*births[1]*births[0]
P0=s.diag(1,0)
for j in (0,1,2,5,10):
    old=s.Matrix(ps[0][j]*Jall*P0*Jall.T*ps[0][j].T)
    new=s.Matrix(ps[1][j]*Jall*P0*Jall.T*ps[1][j].T)
    need(eq(new,V[j]*old*V[j].T),f'actual generated proper cut is transported at interval prefix {j}')

# All three terminal parser effects, including invalid dirty columns.
F0=s.kronecker_product(s.eye(4),s.diag(1,1,0,0))
F1=s.kronecker_product(s.eye(4),s.diag(0,0,1,0))
Fbad=s.kronecker_product(s.eye(4),s.diag(0,0,0,1))
need(eq(F0+F1+Fbad,s.eye(16)),'direct return and invalid effects exhaust the full carrier')
for label,F in [('code0',F0),('code10',F1),('invalid',Fbad)]:
    need(eq(fullp[0][-1].T*F*fullp[0][-1],fullp[1][-1].T*F*fullp[1][-1]),f'all-input future terminal effect {label} pulls back identically')
Ecost=p*F0+p*p*F1
need(eq(fullp[0][-1].T*Ecost*fullp[0][-1],fullp[1][-1].T*Ecost*fullp[1][-1]),'original decoded cost-weighted terminal effect transports exactly')
need(eq(Jall.T*fullp[0][-1].T*Fbad*fullp[0][-1]*Jall,s.zeros(2)),'invalid output is absent on actual canonical input without deleting its full effect')
terminal_matrix=s.Matrix([[i*16+j for j in range(16)] for i in range(16)])
terminal_matrix=terminal_matrix+terminal_matrix.T
need(eq(fullp[0][-1].T*terminal_matrix*fullp[0][-1],fullp[1][-1].T*terminal_matrix*fullp[1][-1]),'an independent coherent future effect is also transported')
need(not eq(ps[0][2].T*Fbad*ps[0][2],ps[1][2].T*Fbad*ps[1][2]),'hostile control: a fixed untransported intermediate test can distinguish the raw histories')

w0=[wa]*10; w1=[wa,wb,wa,wb,wc]*2

for x,y in zip(w0,w1): r.append(s.cancel(r[-1]*y/x))

need(s.cancel(ratio-wb**4*wc**2/wa**6)==0,'the full weighted terminal defect is b4 c2 over a6')
need(s.cancel(ratio.subs({wb:wa,wc:wa})-1)==0,'uniform per-call weights give exact common-length cancellation conditionally')

need(s.cancel(ratio.subs({wa:1,wb:1,wc:2})-4)==0,'hostile symbolic weight assignment defeats weighted equality despite equal full operator')
```

```python
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Exact terminal code-cost operands; no complete Book price is assigned.

The actual 0/10 writer is an explicitly appended operation. Original H.1/EO
has a pre-sign event mark, not this terminal writer. All input columns and
the invalid-code projector are retained. The screened effect is a control
in the weaker code-valid task, never an H.1 substitution.
"""
import argparse
import hashlib
import importlib.util
import json
from pathlib import Path
import sys

import sympy as sp


OWNER = Path("02_REGISTRY/research/sources/d0_native_execution_domain_2026-10-24/native_execution.py")
OWNER_SHA256 = "222eafaffa4b30f175919a32c940534b82f3a2b9af89c7897d318dd004a2007c"


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("--repo", type=Path, default=Path.cwd())
    args = parser.parse_args()
    owner = args.repo / OWNER
    rows = []

    def require(label, condition, kind="exact_symbolic"):
        if condition is not True:
            raise RuntimeError("FAILED: " + label)
        rows.append({"label": label, "kind": kind, "pass": True})

    require("pinned_actual_native_owner", hashlib.sha256(owner.read_bytes()).hexdigest() == OWNER_SHA256,
            "provenance")
    spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("weighted_price_native", owner)
    ne = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
    sys.modules[spec.name] = ne
    spec.loader.exec_module(ne)
    p, a = ne.P, ne.A
    eye = sp.eye
    kron = sp.kronecker_product
    G = sp.Matrix(ne.G_LOCAL)
    v = sp.Matrix([a, p])
    P0, P1 = sp.diag(1, 0), sp.diag(0, 1)
    X = sp.Matrix([[0, 1], [1, 0]])
    Z = sp.diag(1, -1)
    J = sp.Matrix([[0, -1], [1, 0]])

    def zero(expr):
        expr = sp.expand(expr)
        symbols = sorted(expr.free_symbols, key=str)
        coeffs = sp.Poly(expr, *symbols, domain="EX").coeffs() if symbols else [expr]
        return all(ne.GOLDEN_FIELD.from_sympy(c) == ne.GOLDEN_FIELD.zero for c in coeffs)

    def equal(left, right):
        if isinstance(left, sp.MatrixBase) or isinstance(right, sp.MatrixBase):
            diff = sp.Matrix(left) - sp.Matrix(right)
            return all(zero(e) for e in diff)
        return zero(left - right)

    def word(qubits, gates):
        execution = ne.Execution(qubits, (), (), tuple(ne.Gate(op, wires) for op, wires in gates),
                                 profile=ne.G_CX)
        ne.validate_execution(execution, max_qubits=qubits, max_expanded_stages=len(gates))
        return sp.Matrix(ne.word_matrix(execution, max_qubits=qubits, max_expanded_stages=len(gates)))

    UE = word(2, [("CX", (0, 1)), ("G", (1,)), ("CX", (0, 1))])
    require("actual_three_call_writer_all_four_columns", equal(UE, kron(P0, G) + kron(P1, G.T)),
            "native_exact")
    require("writer_orthogonal", equal(UE.T * UE, eye(4)))
    require("canonical_born_and_two_exact_tail_outputs", equal(v.T * v, eye(1)) and
            equal(G * v, sp.Matrix([p**3, 2*a*p])) and equal(G.T * v, sp.Matrix([1, 0])))
    F0, F1, FF = kron(P0, eye(2)), kron(P1, P0), kron(P1, P1)
    require("complete_code_and_failure_partition", equal(F0 + F1 + FF, eye(4)))
    j = kron(eye(2), v)
    W = UE * j
    require("prepared_code_valid_but_failure_columns_retained", equal(FF * W, sp.zeros(4, 2)) and
            not equal(FF * UE, sp.zeros(4, 4)))
    require("sharp_return_effect_all_input", equal(W.T * F1 * W, P1))
    require("actual_expected_code_length", equal(W.T * (F0 + 2*F1) * W, eye(2) + P1))
    chi = sp.Symbol("chi_failure", nonnegative=True)
    cost1 = W.T * (p*F0 + p**2*F1 + chi*FF) * W
    cost2 = W.T * (p**2*F0 + p**4*F1 + chi*FF) * W
    require("raw_cost_probability_weight_effect", equal(cost1, p*eye(2) - p**3*P1))
    require("extra_Book_exponent_on_existing_amplitude_effect", equal(cost2, p**2*eye(2) - p**3*P1))
    require("same_unnormalized_jet_distinct_absolute_mass", equal(cost1 - cost2, p**3*eye(2)))
    q = sp.Symbol("q", real=True)
    Z1, Z2 = p - p**3*q, p**2 - p**3*q
    require("actual_probability_tilt_is_not_preserved", zero(p**2*q - q*Z1 + p**3*q*(1-q)))
    require("two_normalized_source_factors_are_distinct", not zero(2*Z2 - Z1))
    reader = word(2, [("CX", (0, 1))])
    jr = kron(eye(2), v)
    Bsharp = jr.T * reader.T * kron(eye(2), P1) * reader * jr
    require("literal_CX_reader_all_input_return", equal(Bsharp, p**2*P0 + p*P1), "native_exact")
    Hsharp = p*eye(2) - p**3*Bsharp
    require("non_scalar_weighted_operand", equal(Hsharp, sp.Rational(1, 2)*eye(2) + p**6*Z/2))
    require("exact_scalar_intertwining_gap", equal(Hsharp[0, 0] - Hsharp[1, 1], p**6))
    dr, ds = sp.symbols("dr ds", real=True)
    D_rho = sp.Matrix([[dr, ds], [ds, -dr]])
    require("complete_free_preparation_source", equal(sp.trace(D_rho*Hsharp), p**6*sp.trace(D_rho*Z)/2))
    Q = sp.Symbol("Q", real=True)
    qf = p - p**3*Q
    qr = p**2*(1-qf) + p*qf
    z1field = p - p**3*qr
    z2field = p**2 - p**3*qr
    require("actual_XF_reader_probability", equal(qr, p**2+p**4-p**6*Q))
    require("absolute_field_mass_and_both_first_sources", equal(z1field, sp.Rational(1, 2)+p**9*(Q-sp.Rational(1, 2)))
            and equal(sp.diff(z1field, Q), p**9) and equal(sp.diff(z2field, Q), p**9))
    require("mean_code_cost_first_source_not_log_mass", equal(sp.diff(1+qr, Q), -p**6))
    M = a*F0 + p*F1  # failure coefficient is immaterial ONLY after M W; FF W=0 above
    Hfuture = kron(G.T*P1*G, eye(2))
    weighted_future = W.T * M * Hfuture * M * W
    Hpinched = F0*Hfuture*F0 + F1*Hfuture*F1 + FF*Hfuture*FF
    weighted_pinched = W.T * M * Hpinched * M * W
    require("actual_coherent_G_future_has_Gram_term", equal(weighted_future, p**3*eye(2)+p**6*X))
    require("record_diagonal_future_drops_nonzero_term", equal(weighted_pinched, p**3*eye(2)) and
            equal(weighted_future-weighted_pinched, p**6*X))
    require("both_future_outcomes_retained", equal(weighted_future+W.T*M*(eye(4)-Hfuture)*M*W, cost1))
    lam = p**2/(sp.Rational(1, 2)+a*p)
    E_screen = lam*(eye(2)+X)/2
    Bscreen = jr.T*reader.T*kron(eye(2), E_screen)*reader*jr
    require("weaker_task_screen_control_all_input", equal(Bscreen, p**2*eye(2)))
    Hscreen = p*eye(2)-p**3*Bscreen
    require("screened_absolute_mass_not_unit", equal(Hscreen, (p-p**5)*eye(2)) and

    require("complete_fibre_weighted_future_transport", equal((A*A).T*(M*Hfuture*M)*(A*A),
```

```python
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Exact paid pre-sign writer/encoder operands, with independent echo legs.

The inherited central sign is an original EO operation, not a new G/CX
primitive. Only the new CX and three-call code writer use the pinned native
owner. The all-column algebra and source formulas select no new Info law.
"""
import argparse
import hashlib
import importlib.util
import json
from pathlib import Path
import sys
import sympy as sp

OWNER = Path("02_REGISTRY/research/sources/d0_native_execution_domain_2026-10-24/native_execution.py")
OWNER_SHA256 = "222eafaffa4b30f175919a32c940534b82f3a2b9af89c7897d318dd004a2007c"


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("--repo", type=Path, default=Path.cwd())
    args = parser.parse_args()
    owner = args.repo / OWNER
    rows = []

    def require(label, condition, kind="exact_symbolic"):
        if condition is not True:
            raise RuntimeError("FAILED: " + label)
        rows.append({"label": label, "kind": kind, "pass": True})

    require("pinned_native_G_CX_owner", hashlib.sha256(owner.read_bytes()).hexdigest() == OWNER_SHA256,
            "provenance")
    spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("presign_price_native", owner)
    ne = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
    sys.modules[spec.name] = ne
    spec.loader.exec_module(ne)
    p, a = ne.P, ne.A
    G = sp.Matrix(ne.G_LOCAL)
    eye, kron = sp.eye, sp.kronecker_product
    P0, P1 = sp.diag(1, 0), sp.diag(0, 1)
    X, Z = sp.Matrix([[0, 1], [1, 0]]), sp.diag(1, -1)
    J = sp.Matrix([[0, -1], [1, 0]])
    PP, PM = (eye(2)+X)/2, (eye(2)-X)/2
    v = sp.Matrix([a, p])
    e0, e1 = sp.Matrix([1, 0]), sp.Matrix([0, 1])

    def zero(expr):
        expr = sp.expand(expr)
        symbols = sorted(expr.free_symbols, key=str)
        coeffs = sp.Poly(expr, *symbols, domain="EX").coeffs() if symbols else [expr]
        return all(ne.GOLDEN_FIELD.from_sympy(c) == ne.GOLDEN_FIELD.zero for c in coeffs)

    def equal(left, right):
        if isinstance(left, sp.MatrixBase) or isinstance(right, sp.MatrixBase):
            return all(zero(e) for e in (sp.Matrix(left)-sp.Matrix(right)))
        return zero(left-right)

    def word(n, gates):
        ex = ne.Execution(n, (), (), tuple(ne.Gate(op, wires) for op, wires in gates), profile=ne.G_CX)
        ne.validate_execution(ex, max_qubits=n, max_expanded_stages=len(gates))
        return sp.Matrix(ne.word_matrix(ex, max_qubits=n, max_expanded_stages=len(gates)))

    CX = word(2, [("CX", (0, 1))])
    UE = word(2, [("CX", (0, 1)), ("G", (1,)), ("CX", (0, 1))])
    require("literal_added_CX_and_three_positive_call_encoder", equal(CX, kron(P0, eye(2))+kron(P1, X)) and
            equal(UE, kron(P0, G)+kron(P1, G.T)), "native_exact")
    Af, Ab = G, G*G
    W, V = Ab.T*Z*Af, Ab.T*Af
    Upre = kron(Ab.T, eye(2))*kron(Z, eye(2))*CX*kron(Af, eye(2))
    require("independent_legs_exact_all_column_extension", equal(Upre, kron(W, PP)+kron(V, PM)))
    require("full_extension_is_unitary", equal(Upre.T*Upre, eye(4)))
    jv = kron(eye(2), v)
    B0, B1 = kron(eye(2), e0.T)*Upre*jv, kron(eye(2), e1.T)*Upre*jv
    require("complete_conditional_branch_maps", equal(B0, ((a+p)*W+(a-p)*V)/2) and
            equal(B1, ((a+p)*W-(a-p)*V)/2))
    Ef = Af.T*P1*Af
    E1 = B1.T*B1
    require("return_effect_only_forward_event", equal(E1, p**2*eye(2)+p**3*Ef))
    require("nonreturn_effect_and_complete_sum", equal(B0.T*B0, p*eye(2)-p**3*Ef) and
            equal(B0.T*B0+E1, eye(2)))
    require("full_cross_branch_Gram_retained", equal(B0.T*B1, a*p*eye(2)))
    Ucode = kron(eye(2), UE)*kron(Upre, eye(2))
    jrt = kron(eye(2), v, v)
    full0, full1, fullfail = kron(eye(2), P0, eye(2)), kron(eye(2), P1, P0), kron(eye(2), P1, P1)
    require("all_eight_columns_and_terminal_partition", equal(Ucode.T*Ucode, eye(8)) and
            equal(full0+full1+fullfail, eye(8)))
    require("prepared_valid_code_no_failure_column_deleted", equal(fullfail*Ucode*jrt, sp.zeros(8, 2)) and
            not equal(fullfail*Ucode, sp.zeros(8)))
    require("code_preserves_complete_return_effect", equal(jrt.T*Ucode.T*full1*Ucode*jrt, E1))
    cold = jrt.T*Ucode*jrt
    R = sp.Rational(1, 2)+a*p
    require("exact_cold_with_independent_V_leg", equal(cold, a*(R*W+(1-R)*V)))
    chi = sp.Symbol("chi_failure", nonnegative=True)
    Hcost = jrt.T*Ucode.T*(p*full0+p**2*full1+chi*fullfail)*Ucode*jrt
    require("full_raw_code_weighted_effect", equal(Hcost, (p**2+p**4)*eye(2)-p**6*Ef))
    require("actual_expected_code_cost_effect", equal(jrt.T*Ucode.T*(full0+2*full1)*Ucode*jrt,
                                                       (1+p**2)*eye(2)+p**3*Ef))
    H2 = jrt.T*Ucode.T*(p**2*full0+p**4*full1+chi*fullfail)*Ucode*jrt
    require("absolute_amplitude_marker_difference", equal(Hcost-H2, p**3*eye(2)))
    dAf, dAb = J*Af, J*Ab
    dEf = dAf.T*P1*Af+Af.T*P1*dAf
    dWf, dVf = Ab.T*Z*dAf, Ab.T*dAf
    dB1f = ((a+p)*dWf-(a-p)*dVf)/2
    require("forward_full_return_first_source", equal(dB1f.T*B1+B1.T*dB1f, p**3*dEf))
    dWb, dVb = dAb.T*Z*Af, dAb.T*Af
    dB1b = ((a+p)*dWb-(a-p)*dVb)/2
    require("independent_backward_terminal_reaction_exact_zero", equal(dB1b.T*B1+B1.T*dB1b, sp.zeros(2)))
    require("backward_cold_reaction_cannot_be_dropped", not equal(a*(R*dWb+(1-R)*dVb), sp.zeros(2)))
    require("nonzero_literal_forward_preparation_source", equal((v.T*dEf*v)[0], 4*a*p**4) and
            not zero((v.T*dEf*v)[0]))
    dUpost = kron(eye(2), J)*Upre
    dUprior = Upre*kron(eye(2), J)
    dBpost = kron(eye(2), e1.T)*dUpost*jv
    dBprior = kron(eye(2), e1.T)*dUprior*jv
    require("post_reader_pointer_rotation_return_row", equal(dBpost.T*B1+B1.T*dBpost, 2*a*p*eye(2)))
    require("pre_reader_pointer_rotation_return_row", equal(dBprior.T*B1+B1.T*dBprior, 2*a*p*(eye(2)-2*Ef)))
    require("post_reader_cold_rotation_sign_and_independent_legs", equal(a*jv.T*dUpost*jv, a*p**3*(V-W)/2))
    require("pre_reader_cold_rotation_opposite_sign", equal(a*jv.T*dUprior*jv, a*p**3*(W-V)/2))
    # Matched protected input: old work is canonical v, a two-dimensional
    # arbitrary protected system is tensored through every retained branch.
    Wm = Z
    B0m, B1m = a*P0-p*P1, p*P0-a*P1
    im = kron(v, eye(2))
    K0, K1 = kron(B0m, eye(2))*im, kron(B1m, eye(2))*im
    Qm = p**2
    q0m, q1m = p-p**3*Qm, p**2+p**3*Qm
    require("arbitrary_protected_input_scaled_isometries", equal(K0.T*K0, q0m*eye(2)) and
            equal(K1.T*K1, q1m*eye(2)))
    h0, h1, h2 = sp.symbols("h0 h1 h2", real=True)
    rho = sp.Matrix([[h0, h1], [h1, 1-h0]])
    require("all_protected_density_branch_masses", equal(sp.trace(K0*rho*K0.T), q0m) and
            equal(sp.trace(K1*rho*K1.T), q1m))
    drho = sp.Matrix([[h0, h2], [h2, -h0]])
    require("free_protected_input_mass_first_source_zero", zero(sp.trace(drho*K1.T*K1)))
    Q, dQ, dCw, dCv = sp.symbols("Q dQ dCw dCv", real=True)
    q = p**2+p**3*Q
    Z1, Z2 = p-p**3*q, p**2-p**3*q
    C = a*(1-2*R*Q)
    require("matched_field_return_and_absolute_weight_jets", equal(sp.diff(q, Q), p**3) and
            equal(Z1, p**2+p**4-p**6*Q) and equal(sp.diff(Z1, Q), -p**6) and equal(sp.diff(Z2, Q), -p**6))
    require("matched_field_cold_source", equal(sp.diff(C, Q), -2*a*R))
    CQ, Ctheta, qQ, qtheta = -2*a*R, a*p**3*Q, p**3, 2*a*p
    determinant = CQ*qtheta-Ctheta*qQ
    require("independent_cold_and_record_response_jacobian", equal(determinant, -4*p**2*R-a*p**6*Q))
    FC = sp.Symbol("F_C", real=True)
    require("conditional_single_row_elimination_retains_cold_source", equal(
        FC*CQ-FC*Ctheta*qQ/qtheta, FC*determinant/qtheta))
    # Cross-multiplied exact J source avoids logarithmic simplification.
    rank, z = sp.symbols("rank z", real=True)
    numerator = -rank*2*z*C*sp.diff(C, Q)
    require("full_proper_cut_feedback_source_sign_coefficient", equal(numerator, 4*rank*z*a*R*C))
    # Actual pointer-preparation tangent b'=Jv; do not declare it admitted.
    db = J*v
    qprepprime = 2*v[1]*db[1]*(1-Q)+2*v[0]*db[0]*Q
    require("new_born_pointer_free_tangent_if_admitted", equal(qprepprime, 2*a*p*(1-2*Q)))
    require("golden_Kraft_minimum_of_actual_code_component", zero(p+p**2-1) and
            equal(q.subs(Q, 0), p**2))
    counts = {}
    for row in rows:
        counts[row["kind"]] = counts.get(row["kind"], 0)+1
    print(json.dumps({"schema": "d0.actual-presign-code-price/1", "owner_sha256": OWNER_SHA256,
        "all_pass": True, "check_count": len(rows), "classifications": counts, "checks": rows,
        "scope": {
            "central_sign_is_inherited_EO_operation": True,
            "new_reader_plus_code_has_four_positive_G_CX_calls": True,
            "two_new_canonical_births_must_be_charged": True,
            "independent_forward_backward_legs_retained": True,
            "matched_CQ_entropy_gain_proved_by_scaled_isometries": True,
            "complete_physical_Info_law_selected": False,
            "old_H_heat_or_Gamma_reused_after_extension": False,
            "all_new_internal_master_rows_proved_zero": False,
            "GR_closed": False}}, sort_keys=True, indent=2))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
```

```text
# Final bounded admission and source-scope review

## Actual native operation and the original task

The opening and brief correctly identify the new result as a paid
extension of the original pre-sign event. They do not identify that
event with the old terminal port or pretend that EO already executed
the added 0/10 writer. The original H.1 graph, stronger complete FN
fibre and weaker later code-valid family are kept separate.

The actual extension preserves the original first PORT birth, original
SourceSpin addresses and original front-birth order, then adds r,t in
their canonical birth states before the square body. Its added calls
are one CX at the real pre-sign address and the three-call E_0 encoder.
All calls act on live permitted supports. The original paid reverse
body is retained; no new inverse or zero blank is supplied.

The all-column identities, code branch maps and proper cut are correct.
The new initialized cut retains the original rank and unknown/reference
columns. The direct tail remains quantum WORK; the invalid dirty
columns remain in the complete unitary even though the initialized
invalid outcome is exactly zero. Actual stage dimensions and the true
last CX are used, with no constant-width padding of earlier fibres.

Every pre-insertion mark keeps its actual extended operator and shifted
address. Later marks require their true suffix transport. The new full
endpoint is not an FN replacement of the old W. A faithful implementation
constraint is applied only to the newly specified complete tuple, with
its real normal reaction and generated-state adjoints.

## Independent variables and the exact source scope

Independent forward/back occurrences retain both
`W=A_b* Z A_f` and `V=A_b* A_f`. In particular,
`C_ext=a[R C_W+(1-R)C_V]`; V is not set to I before differentiation.
The terminal probability depends on the forward event, while the
return keeps both legs. Thus the entire price source is not reconstructed
from the terminal probability alone.

The four original preparation zeros are now expressly limited to
their constructed CD3 centres. The source section does not infer an
off-shell stationary nuisance section from those zeros. The added
exact identity `DJ_new=eta DJ_old` keeps nonzero off-shell components
on precisely the tangent map satisfying `Re Tr(DC_V)=0`, at the stated
scalar corners and fixed z. The positive eta and transported frozen
gain have their actual denominators. Extra input/old-Gram/pointer rows
outside those hypotheses remain.

The matched field pullback and the verified centre rows are separately
stated. The full nonreflection heat is controlled by the original
arbitrary-unitary clock estimate, with every new dimension, occurrence
and normalized lift retained. No old exact finite thermal zero or
finite EO root is transplanted to the changed word.

The post-reader pointer derivative and the nonzero two-response
Jacobian are correct. They supply an independent cold/record operand;
they do not prove an admitted nuisance stationary section or select a
full price F(C,q). The compiled-control and task-reaction caveats are
present. Merely valid code cannot remove this real current row.

## Terminal information and weighted continuation

The terminal CQ calculation retains the whole conditional bank and
reference states. Chi=0 is proved on the actual scaled-isometry fibre.
The stronger first-derivative statement uses chi>=0 and the stated
fixed-support, positive-branch regularity; it is not an off-fibre
identity or a supplied physical purification. Changed support requires
the separate continuity gate.

Parsed length, probability cost marker, additional amplitude marker,
terminal CQ component and H+J remain different typed quantities with
their separate absolute normalizers. No primitive unit tariff or
Book03 Info is assigned by calling the instruction list paid.

The ten-CX FN example transports the supplied terminal operator on the
same final quantum carrier. The final WQ3 qualification keeps raw
instruction labels distinct and requires a separate map for policies
or readouts chosen from differing logs. It is not an equivalence of
all native future profiles. All coherent future effects and intermediate
mark transports remain explicit in the correct contextual diagram.
```

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Bounded exact CQ obstruction on the original pre-sign cold-max fibre.

Consumes the owned certified kappa512 packet; does not rerun its old suite,
fit Q, search roots, or assign complete Book Info. All numeric-looking
bounds are directed rational interval certificates, never float tests.
"""
import argparse
from fractions import Fraction as F
import hashlib
import importlib.util
import json
from math import isqrt
from pathlib import Path
import sys
import sympy as sp

OWNER = Path('02_REGISTRY/research/sources/d0_native_execution_domain_2026-10-24/native_execution.py')
OWNER_SHA = '222eafaffa4b30f175919a32c940534b82f3a2b9af89c7897d318dd004a2007c'
PRIMARY = Path('02_REGISTRY/research/A4D_NONVACUUM_SAME_REPRESENTATIVE_PAID_SOURCE_RESIDUAL_2026_10_20.md')
KAPPA_SHA = 'e5dc1217878c920c15b40149d7e9cc16befa416b8e8dafae10aa33f16cc39325'
GRID = 2**160


def floor_grid(x):
    return F((x.numerator*GRID)//x.denominator, GRID)


def ceil_grid(x):
    return -floor_grid(-x)


class I:
    def __init__(self, lo, hi=None):
        self.lo, self.hi = F(lo), F(lo if hi is None else hi)
        if self.lo > self.hi:
            raise ValueError('reversed interval')

    @staticmethod
    def cast(x):
        return x if isinstance(x, I) else I(x)

    @staticmethod
    def rounded(lo, hi):
        return I(floor_grid(lo), ceil_grid(hi))

    def __add__(self, other):
        other = I.cast(other)
        return I.rounded(self.lo+other.lo, self.hi+other.hi)
    __radd__ = __add__

    def __neg__(self):
        return I(-self.hi, -self.lo)

    def __sub__(self, other):
        return self + (-I.cast(other))

    def __rsub__(self, other):
        return I.cast(other) + (-self)

    def __mul__(self, other):
        other = I.cast(other)
        values = [x*y for x in (self.lo,self.hi) for y in (other.lo,other.hi)]
        return I.rounded(min(values),max(values))
    __rmul__ = __mul__

    def reciprocal(self):
        if self.lo <= 0 <= self.hi:
            raise ZeroDivisionError('interval crosses zero')
        return I.rounded(1/self.hi, 1/self.lo)

    def __truediv__(self, other):
        return self * I.cast(other).reciprocal()

    def __rtruediv__(self, other):
        return I.cast(other) / self

    def __pow__(self, exponent):
        if type(exponent) is not int or exponent < 0:
            raise ValueError('only nonnegative integer powers')
        result = I(1)
        for _ in range(exponent):
            result = result*self
        return result

    def sqrt(self):
        if self.lo < 0:
            raise ValueError('negative square root')
        lower = isqrt((self.lo.numerator*GRID**2)//self.lo.denominator)
        upper = isqrt((self.hi.numerator*GRID**2)//self.hi.denominator)+1
        return I(F(lower,GRID),F(upper,GRID))

    def contains_inside(self, lo, hi):
        return F(lo) < self.lo <= self.hi < F(hi)

    def json(self):
        return {'lower':str(self.lo), 'upper':str(self.hi)}


def main():
    parser=argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument('--repo',type=Path,default=Path.cwd())
    args=parser.parse_args()
    rows=[]

    def need(label,condition,kind='exact_symbolic'):
        if condition is not True:
            raise ArithmeticError('FAILED: '+label)
        rows.append({'label':label,'kind':kind,'pass':True})

    owner=args.repo/OWNER
    need('pinned_original_native_G_owner',hashlib.sha256(owner.read_bytes()).hexdigest()==OWNER_SHA,'provenance')
    spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('joint_price_native',owner)
    ne=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
    sys.modules[spec.name]=ne
    spec.loader.exec_module(ne)
    primary=(args.repo/PRIMARY).read_text()
    marker=json.dumps('original_'+'kappa9')+': '+chr(123)
    need('unique_owned_original_kappa_packet',primary.count(marker)==1,'provenance')
    where=primary.index(marker)
    begin=primary.rfind('```json',0,where)+len('```json')
    end=primary.index('```',where)
    packet=json.loads(primary[begin:end])['original_kappa9']
    packet_bytes=json.dumps(packet,sort_keys=True,separators=(',',':')).encode()
    need('owned_kappa_packet_exact_hash',hashlib.sha256(packet_bytes).hexdigest()==KAPPA_SHA,'provenance')
    need('owned_packet_is_actual_512_native_angle',
         packet['definition']=='sin^2(512 theta_G), sin(theta_G)=p' and
         packet['intervals'][-1]['power']==512 and packet['rounding_denominator_bits']==128,'provenance')
    last=packet['intervals'][-1]
    kap=I(F(last['lower']),F(last['upper']))

    p,a=ne.P,ne.A
    def zero(expr):
        numerator=sp.together(expr).as_numer_denom()[0]
        numerator=sp.expand(numerator)
        symbols=sorted(numerator.free_symbols,key=str)
        coeffs=sp.Poly(numerator,*symbols,domain='EX').coeffs() if symbols else [numerator]
        return all(ne.GOLDEN_FIELD.from_sympy(c)==ne.GOLDEN_FIELD.zero for c in coeffs)
    G=sp.Matrix(ne.G_LOCAL)
    need('actual_G_sine_and_cosine',zero(G[1,0]-p) and zero(G[0,0]-a) and zero(a*a-p))
    need('owned_angle_doubling_law_matches_native_G',zero((G*G)[1,0]**2-4*p**2*(1-p**2)))
    c,k,A=sp.symbols('c k A',real=True)
    R=sp.Rational(1,2)+a*p
    S=1-R
    d=R*c*c+S
    t=R*S*(1-c*c)/d
    b=-c*R*p**3*(1-c*c)/(2*d)
    r=1-t
    A2=p**3/(1-p**4)
    K2=1-A2
    need('Golden_R_S_product',zero(R*S-p**6/4))
    need('normalized_valid_report_coordinates',zero(A2-(sp.Rational(1,2)-sp.sqrt(5)/10)) and zero(A2*K2-sp.Rational(1,5)))
    need('rho_n_m_offdiagonal_ratio',zero(b/t+c*(a+p)/(a-p)))
    need('rho_n_m_determinant',zero(r*t-b*b-R*S*(1-c*c)))
    need('quadratic_q_complete_square',zero(A*A*r+2*A*k*b+k*k*t-
           (A*A*d+t*(k-A*c*(a+p)/(a-p))**2)))
    need('exact_q_endpoint_pair',zero(A2*r+K2*t-(A2+t/sp.sqrt(5))) and
         zero(2*sp.sqrt(sp.Rational(1,5))*b-2*b/sp.sqrt(5)))
    # A unit output SO(3) tangent is constructed from e and v=(I-ee*)sigma e.
    rr,bb,dd,tt,zz,ww=sp.symbols('rr bb dd tt zz ww',real=True)
    sigma=sp.Matrix([[rr,bb,dd],[bb,tt,zz],[dd,zz,ww]])
    ee=sp.Matrix([1,0,0]); vv=sp.Matrix([0,bb,dd])
    skew=ee*vv.T-vv*ee.T
    need('explicit_full_domain_report_gradient_witness',zero((ee.T*(skew*sigma-sigma*skew)*ee)[0]-2*(bb*bb+dd*dd)))
    need('gradient_witness_has_operator_norm_squared_v_squared',all(zero(x) for x in skew**3+(bb*bb+dd*dd)*skew))

    # New application of the owned interval, with directed rational arithmetic.
    pi=(I(5).sqrt()-1)/2
    ai=pi.sqrt()
    need('Golden_interval_positive_root_isolation',pi.lo*pi.lo+pi.lo-1<0 and pi.hi*pi.hi+pi.hi-1>0,'certified_interval')
    need('actual_kappa_512_tight_enclosure',kap.contains_inside(F(93793197770933667,10**17),F(93793197770933668,10**17)), 'certified_interval')
    Qi=4*kap*pi**7
    ci=1-2*Qi
    need('actual_Q0_not_chosen',Qi.contains_inside(F(12921646400972442,10**17),F(12921646400972443,10**17)),'certified_interval')
    need('actual_c_positive_regular',ci.contains_inside(F(74156707198055115,10**17),F(74156707198055116,10**17)),'certified_interval')
    Ri=I(F(1,2))+ai*pi; Si=1-Ri
    di=Ri*ci**2+Si
    ti=Ri*Si*(1-ci**2)/di
    bi=-ci*Ri*pi**3*(1-ci**2)/(2*di)
    A2i=pi**3/(1-pi**4); K2i=1-A2i
    need('strictly_positive_pointer_state',ti.lo>0 and Ri.lo>0 and Si.lo>0 and ci.hi<1,'certified_interval')
    need('quadratic_vertex_strictly_outside_allowed_k',
         (A2i*ci**2*Ri-K2i*Si).lo>0 and bi.hi<0,'certified_interval')
    root5=I(5).sqrt()
    qlo=A2i+(ti+2*bi)/root5
    qhi=A2i+(ti-2*bi)/root5
    need('sharp_fibre_lower_endpoint_enclosure',qlo.contains_inside(F(21898686442710212,10**17),F(21898686442710214,10**17)),'certified_interval')
    need('sharp_fibre_upper_endpoint_enclosure',qhi.contains_inside(F(34388166613545757,10**17),F(34388166613545759,10**17)),'certified_interval')
    need('entire_fibre_q_between_point218_and_point344',qlo.lo>F(109,500) and qhi.hi<F(43,125),'certified_interval')
    need('Kraft_stationary_probability_unattainable',qhi.hi<(pi**2).lo,'certified_interval')
    delta=Ri*Si*(1-ci**2)
    discriminant=(1-4*delta).sqrt()
    eiglo=(1-discriminant)/2; eighi=(1+discriminant)/2
    need('pointer_eigenvalues_separated_from_entire_fibre',eiglo.hi<F(7,1000) and eighi.lo>F(993,1000),'certified_interval')
    need('variance_uniform_lower_bound_point13',
         (F(109,500)-F(7,1000))*(F(993,1000)-F(43,125))>F(13,100),'exact_rational')
    need('negative_CQ_slope_less_than_minus_one_third',
         F(43,82)**3<(pi**4).lo,'certified_interval')
    need('unit_operator_tangent_CQ_gradient_exceeds_six_twentyfifths',
         F(4,9)*F(13,100)>F(6,25)**2,'exact_rational')
    need('both_signed_cold_maxima_have_same_q_range',zero(
         A*A*r+2*A*k*b+k*k*t-((-A)**2*r+2*(-A)*(-k)*b+(-k)**2*t)))
    need('five_control_unscreened_probability',zero(A2-p**2/(1+p**2)))
    need('five_control_CQ_slope_exact_minus_one',zero(A2/(1-A2)-p**2))
    need('five_control_full_CQ_gradient_squared_four_fifths',zero(4*A2*(1-A2)-sp.Rational(4,5)))
    bx,by=sp.symbols('bx by',real=True)
    dN2=2*(1-c*c)*bx*by
    residual=sp.expand(dN2**2-4*(1-c*c)**2*bx**2*(1-bx**2))
    need('five_control_envelope_criticality_on_actual_rotation_circle',zero(
         residual-4*(1-c*c)**2*bx**2*(bx**2+by**2-1)))
    Qcollar=I(F(12921,100000),F(6461,50000))
    cc=1-2*Qcollar; dc=Ri*cc**2+Si
    tc=Ri*Si*(1-cc**2)/dc
    bc=-cc*Ri*pi**3*(1-cc**2)/(2*dc)
    qlc=A2i+(tc+2*bc)/root5; qhc=A2i+(tc-2*bc)/root5
    disc_c=(1-4*Ri*Si*(1-cc**2)).sqrt()
    emin_c=(1-disc_c)/2; emax_c=(1+disc_c)/2
    need('actual_Q0_strictly_inside_declared_rational_collar',
         Qcollar.lo<Qi.lo<=Qi.hi<Qcollar.hi,'certified_interval')
    need('same_complete_CQ_gap_on_whole_Q_collar',
         (A2i*cc**2*Ri-K2i*Si).lo>0 and bc.hi<0 and
         qlc.lo>F(109,500) and qhc.hi<F(43,125) and
         emin_c.hi<F(7,1000) and emax_c.lo>F(993,1000),'certified_interval')
    counts={}
    for row in rows: counts[row['kind']]=counts.get(row['kind'],0)+1
    print(json.dumps({'schema':'d0.presign-joint-component-price/1','all_pass':True,'check_count':len(rows),
      'classifications':counts,'checks':rows,'owner_sha256':OWNER_SHA,'owned_kappa_packet_sha256':KAPPA_SHA,
      'rational_intervals':{'p':pi.json(),'kappa512':kap.json(),'Q0':Qi.json(),'c0':ci.json(),
       'rho_nn':(1-ti).json(),'rho_nm':bi.json(),'rho_mm':ti.json(),'q_min':qlo.json(),'q_max':qhi.json(),
       'lambda_min':eiglo.json(),'lambda_max':eighi.json(),'Q_collar':Qcollar.json(),
       'collar_q_min':qlc.json(),'collar_q_max':qhc.json()},
      'scope':{'actual_original_Q0':True,'new_root_or_fitted_Q':False,
       'terminal_CQ_component_only':True,'entire_local_code_valid_target_domain':True,
       'full_unknown_price_is_H_plus_J_plus_CQ':False,'old_fixed_E0_fibre_replaced':False,
       'native_approximation_source_budget_follows_from_density_alone':False,'GR_closed':False}},sort_keys=True,indent=2))


if __name__=='__main__':
    main()

````text
# Independent combined price/source review — §7fp

5 November 2026. Bounded read-only review; no unchanged scientific tests run.
Reviewed combined proof SHA-256:
`b451e158073a1ffaf3f846f081cad873377bd7ffddce57f604c199414ff55eba`.

## Verdict and one normalization precision

The combined argument is mathematically sound at the stated local target,
native transport and full-norm hypotheses. The opening and brief correctly
separate the constructive five-control master section, its terminal-CQ
source mismatch, and the informative-response violation. The response
constraint excludes this section from the original fixed-response task;
the proof does not call native code validity a replacement for that guard.

One explicit precision is needed at the end of §A.8.5: JS35–36 imply a
positive lower bound for the **unnormalized** CQ code covector. To infer
nonvanishing after a CQ normalization, separately require its actual
supplied calibration `0<Gamma_CQ<=M_CQ`. It must not be silently identified
with the feedback calibration Gamma in JS35–36. At the exact five-control
section q_* is field-independent, so the fixed-section field-CQ gain is
zero, and cannot itself be declared a positive calibration. §B.5 already
states the bounded-positive CQ proviso for the four-control calculation;
the five-control normalized conclusion should repeat or reference it.
No new source calculation or test is required for that clarification.

## Cross-checks

1. **Full matrix stationary section.** JS31 is correct even for independent
   old W,V. At b_+, P_-b_+=0, so C_proper=sC_W. Every post-code tangent
   sends the initialized plus vector into S perpendicular to y, annihilated
   by xi; the V coefficient stays zero. The pre-reader tangent lies in the
   minus eigenspace and is mapped to b_out perpendicular to xi. Thus all
   five local derivatives of the full cold matrix vanish without assuming
   the old corner scalar. This is stronger than a scalar feedback trace
   cancellation and is used correctly.

2. **Included old source and gain.** At the stated scalar old corner, the
   full old matrix differential transports by
   `eta_+=s²[(1-z)+zc²]/[(1-z)+zs²c²]`. No DC_V trace premise is needed on
   this section, since the V coefficient is exactly zero. The current
   nonzero off-shell rows remain nonzero after multiplication. Actual
   finite-word alpha_n,C_n and target/actual gain discrepancies are retained;
   no nonscalar native corner is converted into a scalar one by notation.

3. **Saddle rather than selected minimum.** The mixed family
   `C=s[c cos(delta)cos(lambda)-sin(delta)sin(lambda)]` is correctly signed.
   Pure preparation at fixed code raises J, whereas lambda=-delta lowers J
   for 0<c<1. The opening and brief do not confuse this joint saddle with
   the field-screening minimum at R_b=0 or with a physical selector.

4. **Robust all-five estimate.** Let k_*=sign(C)sH_cb/n. From ||k||<=s,
   `||k-k_*||²<=2(s²n²-C²)/n²`. The pre-row discrepancy is therefore at
   most sqrt(2)Delta/n. Substituting
   `Delta=2|alpha|g_h epsilon_U`, `|alpha|<=s sqrt(R)` and
   `|R'|=2sqrt(R(1-R))` gives exactly JS36. Division by sqrt(R) is justified
   by nonzero actual feedback gain. With c in a strict compact subinterval
   of (0,1), bounded g_h and the stated norm conversion, normalized local
   master/heat/native errors tending to zero force R->1 and |C|->sc.
   Hence neither C->0 nor R->0 can hide an unsolved row through its vanishing
   feedback gain. A different heat-dominated calibration is expressly open.

5. **Whole terminal CQ component.** At these limit sections the initialized
   code image is ±y, q_*=p²/(1+p²), and the retained conditional bank maps
   are scaled isometries. Thus the specified whole two-label terminal
   component has f'(q_*)=-1 and full code-source norm2/sqrt(5). It is not
   an entropy of a discarded marginal. The four-control canonical Q0
   certificate and its exact rational collar independently give the
   >6/25 bound. Criticality only along a flat maximum circle is not used
   as a substitute for full local stationarity.

6. **Actual response guard.** The exact gap
   `q_orig-q_*=p⁴/(1+p²)+p³Q>=p⁴/(1+p²)>0` proves this stationary code
   cannot implement original NPS10, including at Q=0. This is a concrete
   code-valid-task versus informative-task distinction; it is not a new
   claim that the original task is impossible. Genuine guard reactions
   must be retained if those directions are excluded.

7. **Complete-price boundary.** Neither proof nor brief adds CQ to H+J.
   The master is its specified full Book03 law. The scalar versus amplitude
   weighting, coherent memory Gram terms, proper initial/terminal operands,
   actual full native Cost−Info and weighted-fibre sums remain their real
   separate binding requirements. The component incompatibility changes
   this local route; it is not a no-go for every actual full physical price.

## Embedded-source reproducibility check

Without executing the checker again, extracted the Python fence and compared
it byte for byte with the final standalone source. They match, SHA-256
`b094707b0e769bfa01d6bdb2ebdfdcf5366940563e0146ea1b548f3dae8f8c0c`.
The assembled proof contains zero literal packet-marker occurrences, and

`37b2143dee4d8f870822be142db47fef3a7d26bc39b8aafa91850a41708452a6`.

Final corrected snapshot acceptance will be pinned below. No repository
files were changed by this review.

## Additional exact finite-pair witness checked algebraically

The proposed §A.8.6 witness is correct. For `e=|10>`,
`h=|0> tensor v=(a,p,0,0)`, the vectors are orthonormal and
`K=e h^T-h e^T` has operator norm one, fixes |11>, and rotates their plane.
Since `y=(a/s)(h+p e)`,

    exp(tK)y=(a/s)[(cos t-p sin t)h+(sin t+p cos t)e].

With O_+ fixed, `U(t)=exp(tK)U_+` therefore gives the matrix identity
`C_proper(t)=s cos(t) C_W` for arbitrary independent W,V. The V branch
remains absent. Thus J(+t)=J(-t) exactly, including a nonscalar old C_W,
because the determinant depends only on `s²cos²(t) C_W* C_W`.

The return probability is `(sin t+p cos t)²/(1+p²)`, so
q'(0)=2/sqrt(5) and the terminal CQ contrast tends to -2/sqrt(5).
All ideal branch conditional outputs remain scaled isometries for arbitrary
old input and chi(t)=0. Native comparison words must separately control
their actual operator/cut and full CQ price/entropy errors after division
by the real `2|t|` and the selected calibration. The CL heat estimate does
not replace that CQ error budget. The target exp(tK) is not a new free
physical primitive. No scientific test rerun is needed for these identities.
````

````text
## Actual gain and finite-source control
````
